description: THE JOB Reading this to the end is worth it. The Company: Why mute-labs? mute-labs is the EU market leader in acoustic phone booths, with more than 20,000 cabins sold and counting. We are self-funded, profitable since day one, and have no investors to answer to and no exit to chase. What we do have is a steep growth curve in revenue, a product made in Germany, and a genuine mission: giving the modern office some quiet back. We have built a strong direct and dealer business on the back of inbound demand and word of mouth. What we have not built yet is a real outbound engine for winning bigger accounts on purpose, from ambitious growth companies to household names like Volkswagen, adidas, IKEA, Red Bull, or Axel Springer, who already trust us today. That gap is this role, and how far into that world you grow is largely up to you. Outbound is not a new idea for us. We have piloted it in smaller pockets already, testing signal-based outreach and structured sequences with real results. What has been missing is someone to own this as a dedicated motion for bigger accounts rather than a side project squeezed in between other things. That is why we are building this out as a new department and you’d be joining a small, yet focussed team as one of the first hires. The Role: Build the Pipeline AND the Channel This is a founding position. You are not stepping into an existing sales org with a quota handed down from three reps before you. You are the first one in the building. What you build, and how you build it, is largely up to you and your team, and you can grow the size and ambition of your target accounts as you find your footing. Green Field, Full Ownership: Build your own pipeline from scratch. There is no inherited book of business and no recycled leads. The customer base you build is yours, and so is the revenue you generate from it. Your Stack, Your Sequences: Clay, Reply.io, LinkedIn Premium, and Aircall are all at your disposal. You design your own outreach sequences, run your own cold calling campaigns, and decide how the machine works. Nobody hands you a script. Segment Strategy, Together: You understand the market as well as anyone. Rather than being handed a target list from above, you and your manager will decide together which segments and account types are worth focusing on. Comp That Rewards More Than the First Deal: An uncapped bonus with a kicker for overperformance. Returning customers you bring in keep feeding your comp over time, not just the initial close. Landing an account well is worth more than landing it once. A Brand That Opens Doors: You are not cold-calling on behalf of an unknown startup. mute-labs is an established, well-regarded market leader with a reference list that already includes some of the biggest names in German and European business. That credibility is yours to use from day one. A seasoned team to back you up: Your manager has built and run outbound and enterprise sales hands-on, from cold pipeline to six-figure closes, and will work closely with you from day one, coaching, supporting, and training wherever it's actually needed rather than just checking in on numbers. Is This You? The Go-Getter: You do not wait to be told what to do next. You get on your feet quickly, figure out the shape of the problem, and start moving before anyone has to push you. Sales Experience: You have carried a full sales cycle before, from first contact to signed contract, and know how to keep a deal moving without needing someone else to close it for you. You do not need to have sold into large enterprises already, that is something you will grow into here. Stakeholder Management: You know how to work a deal with more than one person in the room, decision-makers, influencers, and budget holders, and you can keep several of those relationships moving in parallel without losing the thread. Comfortable with Ambiguity: There is no existing playbook to inherit here. You will help write it. If you need every process defined for you before you can start, this is not the role. Fluent in German and English: Most of your target accounts are DACH-based, though the reference list extends across the EU. Strong German is expected; English is the internal working language. Our Hiring Process We keep this fast and honest, on both sides. The Spark: A short intro call with our People team to check for basic fit. The deepdive: A conversation with your future manager Patrick about your experience, how you build your pipeline and how you close. Here you’ll also meet the rest of the team. The Live Action: A live discovery or negotiation role-play based on a realistic enterprise scenario. No prep deck, just show us how you actually work a deal. The Vision: A final conversation with Leah, Head of Sales as well as Franziskus, Managing Director, on the strategic mandate behind this role and where it can go from here. ABOUT US mute-labs exists to make quiet a normal part of the modern workplace. A few things that set us apart: We are "no tech": we build and sell real hardware, sound-insulated phone and meeting booths that companies actually need. We have no investors, and we are not looking for any. We have been profitable since day one. We are on a steep growth curve, measured in revenue and profit, not headcount for its own sake. We are not building toward an exit. We are building a company meant to last for generations. Skip the Queue Told you it was worth reading to the end. We are looking for someone with a go-getter attitude who does not wait around for permission. So here is your first test: don't apply through the form. Student steht auf dem Vertrag, nicht auf deiner Rolle. Urban Sports Club oder Job Ticket: healthy team, happy team Late Dinner im Office: Wenn es abends länger wird, übernehmen wir dein Dinner (Uber Eats) Offsite: bis jetzt waren wir am Lago Maggiore, in den Alpen und am Tegernsee, what's next? Chance auf Übernahme: Wenn du besonders gut bist, wollen wir, dass du bleibst. Denk von Anfang an nicht daran, wo das endet, sondern wo es hinführen könnte. Die beste Idee gewinnt, egal von wem sie kommt. Titel entscheiden hier keine Diskussion. Noch ein paar Worte zum Abschluss Bewirb dich jetzt! Wir freuen uns über Deine formlose Bewerbung - alles weitere besprechen wir gemeinsam. Egal, welchen Hintergrund, welche Herkunft oder welche Geschlechtsidentität du mitbringst – bei uns zählt, wer du als Person bist. Wir fördern eine Kultur des Respekts und Miteinanders, in der jede Stimme gehört wird, persönliche Weiterentwicklung möglich ist und Wertschätzung an erster Stelle steht. Independent retailers around the globe collectively represent a multi-hundred-billion-dollar wholesale market that has historically been fragmented and offline. Picture your favorite boutique in town — we help them discover the best products from around the world to sell in their stores. With the right tools and insights, we believe that we can level the playing field so businesses can grow and local communities can thrive.

We’re looking for smart, resourceful and passionate people to join us as we power the shop local movement. If you believe in community, come join ours.

You will own a concentrated portfolio of Faire’s highest-value DACH brands, running complex, multi-stakeholder deal cycles from first outreach through C-suite negotiation. You bring a strong commercial mindset, comfortable operating at the most senior levels of an organisation, and you use AI, data, and sharp instincts to outperform. Identify and win the right opportunities

  • Set your own sub-targets, hold yourself accountable, and know exactly what levers to pull when performance is under pressure, across fewer, larger, longer-cycle deals rather than a high-volume motion
  • Use business data, category insights, AI-powered tooling, and your own DACH market knowledge to build a pipeline that is both strategically targeted and high quality
  • Support new enterprise brands through their first quarter on Faire, ensuring they understand the platform and are set up to receive orders and grow

Lead a best-in-class enterprise sales cycle

  • Lead every customer interaction with a personalised, insight-led approach: understanding each brand’s unique business and shaping Faire’s value proposition to their specific problems, delivered natively in German where needed
  • Navigate multi-threaded, multi-quarter deals with confidence: from C-suite and board-level vision conversations to operational onboarding with sales, marketing, legal, and finance teams
  • Develop tailored onboarding plans that balance near-term activation with long-term platform success at enterprise scale
  • Make independent, well-reasoned decisions on when to advance a deal and when to pass, and own the outcome either way
  • Stay resilient and input-focused when performance is challenging; model the standard for the team

Be the expert on the DACH market

  • Be solution-oriented to common objections and DACH-specific blockers, including local business norms, procurement processes, and regulatory considerations. Size the opportunity, identify what’s needed, and act on it with product and leadership
  • Understand how competitors and industry players operate in Germany, Austria, and Switzerland and articulate Faire’s key differentiators with precision, in German and English
  • Research trends, industry events, and key account signals across DACH, and bring that intelligence back to sharpen team strategy

Represent Faire across the wholesale industry

  • Drive Faire’s value props and messaging across the full sales surface: outreach, nurture, DACH trade shows and events, and in-person brand visits
  • Identify and pursue new enterprise business opportunities that drive incremental revenue for the platform
  • Develop German-language content and host webinars to engage leads in your verticals and share onboarding best practices
  • Collaborate with marketing to shape top-of-funnel messaging across paid, web, and nurture channels for the DACH market

Qualifications

Must haves

  • German and English business-fluent, bilingual: mandatory. You will run the full sales cycle, including C-suite/board-level negotiation, natively in German
  • Proven track record of exceeding quota at enterprise/strategic level: top 3 in your org, President’s Club / All-Stars qualifier
  • Enterprise deal experience: comfortable running fewer, larger, multi-stakeholder deals with longer sales cycles, without losing rigor or urgency
  • Sharp executive presence: comfortable operating at C-suite and board level
  • AI fluency: you use AI tools daily to prospect, prep, and accelerate, not as a talking point but as a genuine lever
  • Intellectual curiosity: you ask better questions, dig deeper, and find the unlock others miss
  • Mission alignment: you believe in independent retail and can articulate why Faire matters

Nice to haves

  • Existing network or relationships among large DACH brands
  • Additional European language skills
  • Background in wholesale, retail, or brand partnerships at enterprise scale
  • Experience with Salesforce, Clay, or AI sales tooling

Why you’ll love working at Faire

  • Faire is being built for entrepreneurs, by entrepreneurs. We believe entrepreneurship is a calling and our mission is to empower entrepreneurs to chase their dreams. Every member of our team is an owner of the business and taking part in the founding process.We are entrepreneurs: 
  • We are leveraging the power of product innovation and machine learning to connect brands and boutiques from all over the world, building a growing community of more than 800,000 small business owners.We are using technology and data to level the playing field: 
  • Everything we do is ultimately in the service of helping our customers grow their business because our goal is to grow the pie, not steal a piece from it. Running a small business is hard work, but using Faire makes it easy.We build products our customers love: 
  • Inquisitive by default, we explore every possibility, test every assumption, and develop creative solutions to the challenges at hand. We lead with curiosity and data in our decision making, and reason from a first-principles mentality.We are curious and resourceful: 
  • Sequoia-backed, growing at 45%+ YoY goalbally, and building out our European presence at exactly the right moment, before the category is won. The DACH enterprise book you build today becomes the foundation everyone else inherits tomorrow.

Additionally, hybrid in-office roles will have the flexibility to work remotely up to 4 weeks per year. Specific Workplace and Information Technology positions may require onsite attendance 5 days per week as will be indicated in the job posting. 

Why you’ll love working at Faire

  • Move fast: You'll own meaningful problems that serve customers around the globe with the agency to move fast and see your results clearly.

description:
Your Impact at LILA

The Director, Molecular Discovery is responsible for ensuring our autonomous science platform reliably and repeatedly delivers validated small-molecule drug candidates against designated targets at increasing speed. The platform generates and tests hypotheses at superhuman scale, and you ensure that process translates into real, high-quality compounds that advance toward the clinic.

This role leans heavily into the AI and computational side of our workflow: you will be accountable for throughput, quality, and the operational health of the discovery engine, working hand-in-hand with AI scientists, computational chemists, and platform engineers to diagnose bottlenecks, close feedback loops, and continuously improve how the platform performs.

What You'll Be Building

  • Own small molecule discovery programs against assigned targets, from hit identification through lead optimization and candidate nomination.
  • Serve as the accountable leader for discovery output setting and hitting timelines, quality benchmarks, and throughput targets across active programs.
  • Operate as the primary interface between the autonomous science platform and drug discovery decision-making, ensuring that what the platform produces meets the bar for potency, selectivity, ADMET properties, and developability.
  • Collaborate daily with AI/ML, robotics, and software engineering teams to close the loop between computational predictions and experimental results, driving continuous improvement of the platform's predictive accuracy and experimental efficiency.
  • Architect the components of each discovery program end to end, specifying the required assays, building or sourcing the right capabilities, and managing the scientific staff needed to execute. Define and enforce the quality standards, assay cascades, and decision criteria that govern how compounds progress through the pipeline.
  • Facilitate relationships with CROs and external partners for specialized studies (e.g., in vivo pharmacology, safety pharmacology, DMPK) that sit outside the automated platform.
  • Provide drug discovery expertise to Lila's product team for commercial partnerships, translating platform capabilities into credible value propositions for pharma and biotech collaborators.

What You'll Need to Succeed

  • Ph.D. in medicinal chemistry, computational chemistry, chemical biology, or a closely related discipline.
  • 12+ years of experience in small molecule drug discovery from the computational, medicinal chemistry, or program leadership side with at least 5 years in a senior role closely involved in advancing compounds from hit-to-lead through candidate selection.
  • Demonstrated involvement in programs that delivered clinical candidates, with enough proximity to compound progression decisions to own them whether from the computational, medicinal chemistry, or program leadership side.
  • Deep fluency in medicinal chemistry principles, you may not have practiced bench medchem, but you understand SAR, synthetic tractability, and the multiparameter tradeoffs at the core of lead optimization (potency, selectivity, ADMET, PK, safety) well enough to guide them or define systematic decision frameworks for them.
  • Operational mindset, experience running discovery programs with clear metrics, milestones, and accountability structures, and a comfort level with managing throughput and efficiency alongside scientific quality.
  • Strong working knowledge of ADMET, DMPK, and the data packages required to advance a candidate to IND-enabling studies.
  • Fluency with AI/ML-driven molecular design approaches (generative chemistry, molecular property prediction, free energy methods, active learning) and the practical judgment to know when computational output is actionable and when it needs experimental validation. You don’t need to build models, but you must be a credible, hands-on collaborator with the scientists who do.
  • Effective communicator who can translate complex scientific and operational status into clear updates for leadership.

Bonus Points For

  • Direct experience with automated, high-throughput, or closed-loop discovery environments (e.g., self-driving labs, robotic synthesis and screening platforms), you've seen what it takes to make these systems produce real drug discovery output, not just proof-of-concept demos.
  • Experience applying computational chemistry or cheminformatics in a hands-on capacity, not just consuming model outputs, but contributing to how molecular design hypotheses are generated, scored, and prioritized.
  • Experience building or scaling a discovery operation from early stage, standing up assay cascades, workflows, team structures, and vendor relationships without inheriting a mature infrastructure.
  • Background across multiple therapeutic areas, giving you breadth in target biology and the flexibility to work across a diverse portfolio.
  • Process-oriented thinking: you instinctively look for ways to measure, standardize, and improve how work gets done, without letting process become bureaucracy.

Compensation

We offer competitive base compensation with bonus potential and generous early-stage equity. Your final offer will reflect your background, expertise, and expected impact.

U.S. Benefits. Full-time U.S. employees receive a comprehensive benefits program including medical, dental, and vision coverage; employer-paid life and disability insurance; flexible time off with generous company wide holidays; paid parental leave; an educational assistance program; commuter benefits, including bike share memberships for office based employees; and a company subsidized lunch program.

International Benefits. Full-time employees outside the U.S. receive a comprehensive benefits program tailored to their region. USD salary ranges apply only to U.S.-based positions; international salaries are set to local market.

$202,400—$323,400 USD

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain. Transitions numériques, écologiques, industrielles : les grands défis de notre époque sont aussi ceux de l’Institut Henri Fayol. Ici se mêlent Informatique, Sciences des données, Management, Sciences humaines et sociales, Génie environnemental pour penser les systèmes complexes de demain : territoires, entreprises, filières industrielles. 📊 Résilience, performance, durabilité… Nous développons et expérimentons en lien étroit avec les acteurs socio-économique pour répondre aux exigences des transitions actuelles. ✨ Une recherche interdisciplinaire à fort impact, où l’humain est toujours au centre. Cette thèse de doctorat sera rattachée au département Génie de l'Environnement pour les Organisations (GEO), membre du Laboratoire CNRS UMR 5600 Environnement Ville et Société (EVS). Pour répondre aux enjeux des transitions écologique, énergétique et industrielle, le département GEO accompagne les acteurs des territoires (acteurs publics et privés) vers une meilleure prise en compte des enjeux environnementaux et de résilience territoriale. Il s'attache ainsi à apporter des solutions nouvelles en matière d'analyse, de modélisation et d'évaluation environnementale des systèmes industriels et territoriaux dans un double contexte d'industrie des futurs et de villes et territoires soutenables. 🏠 Contexte Présentation du sujet Le changement climatique met en lumière, comme l'a fait auparavant la crise COVID, les vulnérabilités et liens de dépendance généralisée de nos modes de vie envers les infrastructures, les chaînes de valeur, et modes d'organisation économique et technique, éléments souvent déconnectés de l'usager final, de ses besoins et des conditions d'occupation. Pour le secteur du bâtiment, Cimerman (2023) évoque une tendance depuis plusieurs décennies de « simplification cartésienne » de la conception et de l'opération du bâti. Celle-ci se traduit notamment par le développement d'un imaginaire de « bâtiment-machine », se traduisant par une superposition d'éléments techniques complexes (chauffage, ventilation, climatisation), susceptibles d'être pilotés au travers d'outils informatiques et d'une gestion centralisée optimisée (Cimerman, 2023). Face aux enjeux posés par le changement climatique, deux voies opposées d'adaptation du bâti se dessinent. La première, actuellement dominante, consiste à prolonger cet imaginaire de « bâtiment-machine », rationalisable, mesurable et optimisable, et ce notamment au travers du développement du « smart-building ». Cette approche technosolutionniste apporte des réponses clés-en-main (capteurs, outils de pilotage centralisés, etc.) aux gestionnaires et usagers de bâtiments. Néanmoins, elle présente certains défis pour leur maintenance et leur entretien. Nous pouvons citer le recours massif aux nouvelles technologies, coûteuses, complexes, rapidement obsolètes et dont la fabrication repose en grande partie sur des ressources finies. Cela pose de plus les questions centrales des compétences, de la délégation du savoir et des outils associés à des opérateurs experts externes. En contrepoint à la première voie, une seconde approche, encore marginale, émerge : celle d'un « bâtiment low-tech ». Popularisée ces dernières années en France par Philippe Bihouix (Bihouix, 2014), la low-tech questionne le rapport à la technologie et aux différentes formes de dépendances qu'elle génère (Tanguy et al., 2023). Dans le secteur du bâtiment, l'application de cette démarche renvoie souvent à la dépendance à la ressource (énergie et matière) : repenser les usages, l'origine des matériaux (réemployés, biosourcés) ou encore la simplicité de l'équipement utilisé. Bien que nécessaires, ces travaux s'intéressent pourtant peu à d'autres formes de dépendances associées à la technique, au titre desquelles nous pouvons citer la dépendance aux savoirs et aux formes d'organisation sociale et économique qui conditionnent l'adéquation, la pérennité et l'efficacité des solutions proposées. Cette thèse offre ainsi une immersion concrète dans les questions d'adaptation du parc bâti au changement climatique par la « lowtech » à l'interface entre sciences de l'ingénieur et sciences humaines et sociales. Les compétences et l'expérience acquises trouveront une résonance particulière dans un secteur en pleine mutation, où la maîtrise des dépendances techniques, économiques et organisationnelles devient un enjeu central pour la soutenabilité des bâtiments et de leur exploitation. Contexte scientifique La littérature consacrée à la low-tech s'est structurée ces dernières années autour d'une critique de la fuite en avant technologique et des dépendances qu'elle engendre (Bihouix, 2014 ; Tanguy et al., 2023). Appliquée au bâtiment, cette littérature reste toutefois majoritairement centrée sur la phase de conception et sur la dépendance à la ressource : sobriété énergétique, choix de matériaux biosourcés ou réemployés, réduction du niveau d'équipement technique. Deux angles morts en découlent. Le premier concerne la phase d'exploitation : la maintenance et l'entretien, qui représentent pourtant l'essentiel de la durée de vie d'un bâtiment et conditionnent la performance réelle des solutions installées, sont peu traités comme objet de recherche à part entière. Le second concerne la nature même des dépendances étudiées. Au-delà de la ressource, la conduite d'une opération de maintenance mobilise des savoirs et savoir-faire, des outils de diagnostic, des pièces détachées, des prestataires et des chaînes d'approvisionnement, ainsi que des cadres contractuels et réglementaires. Ces dépendances d’ordres cognitives, organisationnelles, économiques restent largement implicites et sous développées dans les travaux existants. La caractérisation de ces dépendances soulève par ailleurs une question d'échelle. Analysée au seul niveau du bâtiment, la maintenance apparaît comme une somme d'opérations techniques ; replacée à l'échelle urbaine, elle révèle des réseaux d'acteurs, des filières, des compétences localement disponibles ou absentes, et des effets de dépendance mutualisés. Contexte opérationnel Du côté des acteurs institutionnels et économiques, de nombreux outils accompagnent aujourd'hui la gestion technique du patrimoine bâti. Nous pouvons citer : les outils de gestion de maintenance assistée par ordinateur (GMAO) et les plateformes de gestion technique du bâtiment (GTB) ; les démarches de modélisation des données du bâtiment (BIM d'exploitation, jumeaux numériques) et les labels associés à la connectivité des bâtiments ; les contrats d'exploitation et de maintenance externalisés, et les dispositifs de garantie de performance énergétique ; les démarches et retours d'expérience issus de la mouvance low-tech (chantiers démonstrateurs, guides praticiens, réseaux associatifs). Ces dispositifs partagent une orientation commune : ils visent à optimiser la conduite de la maintenance, rarement à interroger les dépendances qu'elle installe. Les démarches low-tech, à l'inverse, portent cette interrogation mais restent au stade de l'expérimentation ponctuelle, sans cadre d'évaluation partagé ni capacité de généralisation à l'échelle d'un parc ou d'un territoire. Il en résulte, en l'état des connaissances aussi bien scientifiques qu'opérationnelles, qu'il n'existe pas de méthode permettant de rendre visibles et de qualifier les dépendances associées à la maintenance et à l'entretien des bâtiments, ni d'évaluer dans quelle mesure une approche low-tech permettrait de les réduire. 🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous Démarche de la thèse L'objectif principal de cette thèse est de caractériser les apports d'une approche low-tech pour cartographier et maîtriser, sinon réduire, les différentes formes de dépendances associées à la maintenance et à l'entretien des bâtiments. Les dépendances analysées s'appuieront sur les techniques, pratiques, outils et réseaux en lien avec la maintenance qui seront mis en évidence dans les deux autres thèses du projet PERENNIS. Cette thèse s'inscrit donc en complète continuité de ces deux travaux. Dans un premier temps, il s'agira de construire un cadre d'analyse des dépendances liées à la maintenance du bâtiment, articulant quatre registres : les ressources (énergie, matière, pièces détachées), les savoirs et savoir-faire, les acteurs et leurs relations contractuelles, et les réseaux techniques et logistiques. Cette phase s'appuiera sur une revue de la littérature scientifique et « grise », sur un benchmark des pratiques et outils de maintenance existants, et sur des entretiens avec les acteurs du secteur (gestionnaires de patrimoine, bailleurs, mainteneurs, bureaux d'études, collectivités). Dans un deuxième temps, ce cadre sera mobilisé pour caractériser et rendre visibles les schémas de dépendance à l'échelle urbaine, sur un ou plusieurs territoires d'étude. Il s'agira notamment d'identifier les sources de données mobilisables pour objectiver ces schémas, de qualifier les points de fragilité et d'apprécier leur variabilité selon les typologies de bâtiments et les configurations d'acteurs. Dans un troisième temps, des stratégies prospectives low-tech de maintenance et d'entretien seront proposées et instruites. Il s'agira de construire des scénarios contrastés, d'évaluer leur capacité à réduire la vulnérabilité technique, économique et sociale des opérations de maintenance dans un contexte d'adaptation au changement climatique, et d'en discuter la faisabilité et l'acceptabilité avec les parties prenantes concernées. Verrous scientifiques : Définition et opérationnalisation de la notion de dépendance appliquée à la maintenance du bâti, au-delà de la seule dépendance à la ressource (savoirs, acteurs, organisations, réseaux) Caractérisation et représentation de schémas de dépendance à l'échelle urbaine, à partir de données hétérogènes et partiellement indisponibles Évaluation prospective de stratégies low-tech en l'absence de retours d'expérience consolidés et de métriques établies Articulation interdisciplinaire entre sciences de l'ingénieur et sciences humaines et sociales, et capacité à répliquer l'approche tout en visant la « parcimonie » des méthodes et modèles Objectifs de développement durable rattachés : ODD 11 – Villes et communautés durables · ODD 12 – Consommation et production responsables ODD 13 – Mesures relatives à la lutte contre les changements climatiques. 🔍 Ce que nous recherchons Formation : Bac +5 en ingénierie généraliste, sciences de l'environnement, génie civil ou énergétique du bâtiment, géographie/aménagement, ou discipline connexe. Une formation ou une sensibilité aux sciences humaines et sociales (sociologie des techniques, STS, économie de la fonctionnalité) serait un plus. Compétences requises : Méthodes qualitatives : conduite et analyse d'entretiens semi-directifs, observation de terrain, analyse de corpus documentaires. Analyse systémique et prospective : capacité à représenter un système sociotechnique, à construire et instruire des scénarios. Connaissance du bâtiment : compréhension du fonctionnement technique du bâti et de ses équipements, et des logiques d'exploitation et de maintenance. Traitement de données : aisance avec des données hétérogènes issues de sources variées ; la maîtrise d'outils de traitement (R, Python) ou de SIG (QGIS) serait appréciée. Gestion de projets : aptitude à structurer et mener des phases de projet de manière autonome, en articulation avec deux autres doctorants du projet. Langue : français courant et anglais opérationnel (capacité à lire des publications techniques et scientifiques en anglais). Profil recherché : individus responsables, proactifs, et dotés d'un esprit analytique, capables de faire preuve de rigueur scientifique. Personnes dynamiques, motivées par les enjeux environnementaux et par le questionnement critique de la technique. Capacité d'adaptation, goût pour le travail interdisciplinaire et collaboratif avec des acteurs variés. 📩 Candidatez dès maintenant ! description: YOU & AHEAD At ahead, we’re on a mission to clean up the world’s candy drawers. We create the snacks people genuinely crave, from chocolate bars and wafers to cookies, gummies, and protein bars, with up to 90% less sugar and no compromise on taste. As our E-Commerce Campaign Manager, you’ll work at the intersection of our products, customer experience, and commercial growth. You’ll help shape how ahead brings ideas to life online and scales them across markets. You’ll take ownership of our onsite campaigns and bring our overarching campaign strategy to life in our shop. You’ll improve the processes behind them, develop & implement new ideas for new campaign-related shop features, and turn campaign data into actionable insights. Working closely with our E-Commerce, Campaign, Brand, and Marketing teams, you’ll help make our campaigns more effective, scalable, and relevant across markets. If you’re commercially curious, highly detail oriented, and motivated by the opportunity to shape both the customer experience and the way we do e-commerce, we’d love to hear from you! YOUR TASKS Onsite Campaign Experience & Launches: Plan and execute product launches, discount initiatives, and other commercial activities in the shop. Coordinate timelines, deliverables, and stakeholders to ensure a smooth customer experience. Content & Asset Ownership: Coordinate the creation of product and shop content, including images, copy, homepage content, launch pages, and other onsite assets. Take full responsibility for their quality, accuracy, and timely delivery, including localization for expansion markets. Ensure content is adapted to local needs and delivered consistently across countries. Shop Development: Together with our Tech team, transform the campaign vision into new shop features, promotional mechanics, and onsite experiences that can improve customer engagement and commercial performance. Process Improvement: Improve how onsite activities are planned, created, and delivered by establishing clearer workflows, strengthening collaboration and handovers, and reducing avoidable errors. Find ways to shorten delivery timelines and assess recurring tasks for automation or AI support. Develop scalable ways of working while using sound judgment about where communication, coordination, and creative thinking remain essential. Performance & Insights: Analyze completed onsite activities, from product launch revenue and discount uplift to top-selling products and other relevant performance indicators, and translate your findings into clear recommendations for future initiatives. YOUR PROFILE You have practical experience in onsite campaign management, shop management, e-commerce, or a similar field. Hands-on experience with onsite campaigns or shop management is essential. You are highly organized, structured, and accurate. You have a low tolerance for errors and take full responsibility for the quality of your work, particularly when managing product copy, campaign assets, and launch details. You combine attention to detail with commercial curiosity. You don’t just execute campaigns – you want to understand what drives performance, what can be improved, and how new ideas can create better results. You are proactive and hands-on. You identify problems, challenge inefficient processes, and follow through on solutions. You’re comfortable working across a broad range of tasks in a fast-moving environment where priorities can evolve. You communicate clearly and confidently in both German and English. You enjoy coordinating with multiple stakeholders and can work effectively with E-Commerce, Marketing, Brand & Design, and other internal teams. You have a basic understanding of D2C business models, digital marketing, and e-commerce performance. WHAT MAKES YOUR PROFILE COMPLETE You are confident working with Shopify. Hands-on Shopify experience is essential for this role. You have worked in a D2C business. You are familiar with Asana, Trello, or similar project management tools. You understand shop and e-commerce performance and how onsite activities can contribute to commercial results. A background in food, consumer goods, retail, or another high-campaign environment is a plus. Experience improving processes, automating tasks, or using AI to work more efficiently is a plus. Exposure to localization and international markets is a plus. AND WHY AHEAD? Working at ahead is more than just a job - it’s your opportunity to develop as a professional and as a person, while shaping the future of snacking. Our mission is to make low sugar the new standard, and we pour that ambition into every product we create. You’ll become part of a team where international talent, startup drive, real impact, and true ownership come together. Hypergrowth Environment: If you're looking for greenfield, creative freedom, and real impact, you're in the right place. We're a team that is scaling fast - with purpose Great Workspace: A central office in the heart of Berlin or Hamburg, top equipment (MacBook), snacks, drinks, plenty of ahead products - and yes, a ping-pong table. We’re also pet-friendly, so you can always bring your furry friend along Amazing Team: Young, international, ambitious - inspiring colleagues who collaborate, support each other, and genuinely enjoy working together Career Growth: Develop through cross-functional projects, structured feedback cycles, and a steep learning curve in a dynamic, high growth environment. We offer a fair, attractive salary with role-dependent bonus opportunities Great Benefits: Fuel yourself with ahead snacks, drinks, and merch - we’ve got you covered. On top: a €50 monthly allowance to spend as you like - Urban Sports Club, mobility options, or vouchers from your favorite brands (IKEA, Rewe, Rossmann and more) Vacation Days: Enjoy 28 vacation days plus two extra days off on December 24 (Christmas Eve) and December 31 (New Year’s Eve) Events & Offsites: Regular after-work hangouts and legendary annual team offsites you won’t forget This role is based in Hamburg or Berlin, with the flexibility of up to 2 home office days per week. If this resonates with you, we'd love to hear from you! description:
About WPP Media

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com.

Dans un souci de clarté et d’accessibilité, nous avons choisi de ne pas utiliser l’écriture inclusive dans nos communications. WPP Media est fermement engagé en faveur de la diversité : nous valorisons l'inclusion et l'égalité, en considérant tous les candidats sans distinction d'identité de genre, d'origine ethnique ou de religion. Tous nos postes sont également ouverts aux personnes en situation de handicap.


A propos de WPP Media :

WPP est le partenaire de confiance des plus grandes marques mondiales pour assurer leur croissance. Nous réunissons une intelligence média de pointe, une créativité de classe mondiale, une production de nouvelle génération, des solutions pour transformer le marketing à l’ère de l’IA et un conseil stratégique d’expert au sein d’une seule compagnie. 
Propulsés par des talents exceptionnels et WPP Open, notre plateforme de marketing agentique, nous déployons l’IA à grande échelle pour aider nos clients à naviguer dans un monde en pleines mutations et à optimiser leurs investissements marketing. 
Pour plus d’informations, visitez www.wpp.com.

WPP Media est le collectif média global de WPP. Dans un monde où les médias sont omniprésents nous regroupons la meilleure plateforme, les meilleurs talents et les meilleurs partenaires pour développer les solutions les plus innovantes, offrant une croissance inégalée à nos clients. Pour plus d'informations, visitez wppmedia.com.

Chez WPP Media, nous croyons en la puissance de notre culture et de nos collaborateurs. C'est grâce à cette synergie que nous parvenons à créer des expériences véritablement exceptionnelles, tant pour nos clients que pour nos équipes internes. Pour réussir dans ce poste, il est fondamental d'incarner les valeurs essentielles qui unissent WPP et WPP Media :

  • Être Extraordinaire en favorisant un leadership collectif qui inspire une créativité véritablement transformationnelle.
  • Créer un environnement Ouvert en trouvant l'équilibre parfait entre l'épanouissement de nos collaborateurs et la satisfaction de nos clients, le tout fondé sur une confiance mutuelle.
  • Diriger avec Optimisme en stimulant activement la croissance et le développement pour mobiliser l'ensemble de notre organisation.


Contexte :

Vous rejoignez WPP Media Commerce, le pôle d'expertise dédié à la croissance omnicanale des clients du groupe. Dans un marché en pleine effervescence, vous intégrerez une équipe dynamique au cœur des stratégies eCommerce.
Le poste sera initialement dédié à un portefeuille de marques emblématiques d'un leader mondial de l'agroalimentaire et des biens de consommation (café, nutrition animale, etc.), et offre des perspectives d'évolution vers d'autres clients d'envergure.

Missions :

  • Gestion de Campagnes de A à Z : Gérer le déploiement opérationnel des campagnes sur les plateformes eRetail (Amazon, Criteo, etc.).
    Cela inclut le paramétrage précis, le suivi quotidien des performances et l'optimisation en continu pour dépasser les objectifs de ROAS et de conversion. Vous assurerez également la gestion financière, du devis à la facturation.

  • Conseil & Partenariat Stratégique : Agir en tant que partenaire de confiance pour vos clients, en traduisant leurs objectifs business en stratégies eRetail Media efficaces.
    Vous développerez et présenterez des recommandations claires (plan d'activation, allocation budgétaire, bilans de campagne) et cultiverez une relation solide avec les clients comme avec les régies partenaires.

  • Analyse & Veille Active : Plonger dans les données de performance (média et retail) pour en extraire des insights pertinents.
    Vous construirez des reportings réguliers et des bilans complets qui racontent l'histoire de vos campagnes et démontrent leur valeur.
    Proactif, vous assurerez une veille constante sur les innovations du marché pour identifier de nouvelles opportunités de croissance pour vos clients.


Profil recherché :

Votre Expérience :

  • Vous justifiez d'une première expérience réussie (stage, alternance ou premier emploi) en agence média ou chez l'annonceur, dans le domaine de la publicité digitale.
  • Vous êtes diplômé(e) d'une formation Bac+4/5 (École de Commerce, de Communication ou équivalent).
  • Vous nourrissez un fort intérêt pour l'univers des médias, du e-commerce et/ou du retail.

Vos Compétences Techniques :

  • Vous maîtrisez la suite Office, en particulier Excel (les TCD n'ont pas de secret pour vous) et PowerPoint pour des présentations claires et impactantes.
  • Une connaissance des plateformes eRetail Media (Amazon, Criteo, Citrus, Unlimitail...) est un véritable atout.
  • La familiarité avec des outils de trading eRetail Media ou d’analyse retail (Pacvue, Skai, Dataimpact, Datagram, …) serait un plus apprécié 
  • Votre niveau d'anglais est opérationnel (B2), vous permettant d'échanger avec des équipes internationales.

Vos Qualités Humaines pour Réussir :

  • Doté(e) d'un excellent esprit d'analyse, vous aimez faire parler les chiffres pour en tirer des conclusions pertinentes et actionnables.
  • Votre rigueur, votre sens de l'organisation et votre proactivité sont vos meilleurs alliés pour gérer plusieurs projets en parallèle avec autonomie.
  • Excellent communicant(e), vous savez présenter vos idées avec clarté et conviction, et vous épanouissez dans le travail d'équipe et la co-construction.
  • Curieux(se) et dynamique, vous êtes en veille constante sur un secteur en perpétuelle évolution.

As the Engineering Manager for the Deliveries squad at HelloFresh, you will lead the engineering vision and execution for how customers control their box week to week. Delivery planning is where correctness, resilience, and scale matter most: every change a customer makes must be applied accurately and in time before cutoff, and the platform must hold up at HelloFresh scale — around 7 million active customers across 18 countries, with close to 1 billion meals delivered a year. You and your team will work in a cross-functional squad with product, frontend, and data.

We are looking for a leader who brings deep backend engineering judgement and is energised by collaborating across disciplines to make HelloFresh better. What you’ll do: The Recipe

  • Lead, inspire and grow a cross-functional team of engineers (backend and frontend), ensuring smooth delivery and continuous improvement of the Deliveries systems and tech real estate.
  • Own the architecture and reliability of the delivery-control experience — skip, pause and resume, reschedule, cadence, delivery day, and address — with a strong focus on correctness, applying changes in time before cutoff, data integrity, and operational excellence.
  • Drive design decisions for scalable, event-driven services (e.g., Kafka) that apply high volumes of delivery changes reliably, with the highest quality and resilience standards.
  • Operate as an engineering leader within a cross-functional squad: partner closely with product, frontend, and data to deliver end-to-end customer outcomes and make joint decisions across disciplines.
  • Champion observability, on-call health, and incident readiness so delivery changes stay accurate and available around the clock.
  • Actively contribute to hiring and capacity planning, conduct regular code reviews, and mentor engineers.
  • Drive a continuous improvement culture and promote the HelloFresh DNA.

What you’ll bring: The Ingredients 

  • You have led a team in an agile environment (5+ engineers), ideally within a cross-functional squad setup.

  • Deep experience building scalable microservices and event-driven systems (e.g., Kafka), especially where correctness, idempotency, and data consistency are critical — such as scheduling, subscription management, or other transactional domains.
  • Experience designing and operating high-throughput backend systems that other teams and customer-facing surfaces depend on.
  • Experience with DevOps practices and cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud), including observability and production ownership.

  • Nice to have: experience with React Native.

description: About Volta Volta is the category-defining, fully vertically integrated AI infrastructure platform – from capital to clusters to software, under a founder-led enterprise. Our mission is The Utility of Compute™: AI infrastructure as dependable and available as electricity, for every organization that needs it. Launched with a $10B strategic partnership with one of the leading frontier AI labs, a Series A led by Andreessen Horowitz, and a $5B AI Infrastructure Fund, Volta is building the infrastructure layer of the AI era from the ground up. We are 100+ people across London, Palo Alto, and New York, with rapid growth expectations to hundreds. About The Role The Finance Business Partner will be embedded within the Project Controllership Organization, acting as the finance owner for large, long-duration capital projects from initial commitment through to completion and transfer to operations. You will bring rigorous project and cost accounting to the delivery teams: owning capex and cost accounting for your projects, building and maintaining project cost structures, tracking budgets, commitments and actuals, reporting variances with insight, and ensuring each project is accounted for accurately under US GAAP and closed out cleanly at completion. This is a hands-on role that pairs technical accounting depth with genuine business partnering - you will sit alongside project directors, engineers and procurement, not apart from them. What You Will Be Doing Project and capex accounting Capex accounting: own end-to-end accounting for assigned capital projects, including construction in progress (CIP/AUC), capitalization assessments under US GAAP (ASC 360), componentization, capitalized interest where applicable (ASC 835-20), and transfer to fixed assets on completion with correct in-service dates and useful lives. Compute and equipment capex: own the accounting for high-value compute and network equipment (GPU fleets and associated infrastructure), including vendor purchase order and financing payment tracking, delivery acceptance and in-service dating, componentization and useful lives, residual value support, and lessor accounting for intra-group equipment leases (ASC 842). Cost accounting: maintain accurate, complete and well-classified project cost records - distinguishing capital from operating expenditure, applying the capitalization policy consistently, and ensuring costs land in the correct entity, project, site and cost category. Project costing: build and own project cost breakdown structures (WBS/cost codes) aligned to contracts, procurement packages and the accounting dimension framework; establish cost baselines and estimates-at-completion (EAC) and keep them current. Accruals and commitments: run monthly cost accruals from contractor applications for payment, certifications and goods receipts; maintain the committed cost position (POs, contracts, change orders) and reconcile committed, accrued and actual spend. Month-end close: deliver project close activities to the group timetable - CIP reconciliations, accrual journals, retention and milestone payment tracking, and balance sheet substantiation for project-related accounts. Reporting, variance analysis and forecasting Variance reporting: produce monthly project cost reports comparing actuals and EAC against budget and prior forecast; explain variances with root-cause commentary and work with project teams on corrective actions. Forecasting: partner with FP&A and Strategic Finance on capex cashflow forecasting, phasing of spend, and funding drawdown planning for your projects. Provide current capex phasing and estimate-at-completion data into Strategic Finance's monthly business plan refresh. Board and investor reporting: contribute project cost and progress data to board packs, lender/investor reporting and management information, ensuring one version of the truth between delivery and finance. Work within, and help build, the group project reporting framework. Balance sheet visibility: own the project-related balance sheet - CIP, retentions, VAT recoverable, prepayments and committed spend - and feed these positions into the group management balance sheet dashboard on an automated, near-real-time basis. Project lifecycle and business partnering Cradle to completion: support projects through their full lifecycle - business case and budget setting, contract award, execution, change management, practical completion, final account settlement, and financial close-out including release of retentions and accrual true-ups. Change control: evaluate the cost and accounting impact of scope changes, change orders and claims; ensure changes are approved, coded and forecast before costs are incurred. Business partnering: act as the trusted finance counterpart to project directors, construction managers, procurement and engineering; challenge constructively, translate financial data into decisions, and embed cost discipline in delivery teams. Contract and procurement support: work with procurement and legal on the financial aspects of construction and equipment contracts (payment mechanisms, milestones, retentions, bonds, liquidated damages) and ensure compliance with the Group Procurement Policy and PO controls. Controls, policy and audit Controls: operate and help design internal controls over project costs, capitalization and payments as part of the group's SOX 404 readiness program, including preparing clear documentation and audit evidence. Policy: apply and help refine group accounting policies (capitalization, PP&E, procurement) and prepare technical accounting analysis for project-specific matters, escalating judgmental issues with well-structured recommendations. Audit: act as the primary project-accounting contact for external audit on assigned projects, preparing schedules, reconciliations and supporting evidence. Anything else that makes sense: as an early hire in a fast-scaling finance function, contribute to systems implementation (ERP selection ongoing), process design, and whatever else is needed to build best-in-class project controllership. What You Bring Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA, CIMA, CPA or equivalent) with strong post-qualification experience. Demonstrable experience of project accounting for large, long-term capital projects - for example data centers, energy, utilities, infrastructure, construction or industrial facilities - covering the full project lifecycle. Deep, practical knowledge of capex and cost accounting: CIP/AUC, capitalization criteria, componentization, accruals from contractor valuations, retentions, and asset transfer at completion. Experience building and managing project cost structures (WBS/cost coding), budgets, committed cost tracking and estimates-at-completion. Strong variance analysis and reporting skills, with the ability to explain cost movements clearly to non-finance stakeholders. Proven business partnering experience embedded with, or working closely alongside, project delivery teams. Advanced Excel and strong data and dashboarding skills, with an automation-first mindset; comfortable working from imperfect data in a scaling environment. Nice To Have US GAAP experience (ASC 360 fixed assets, ASC 835-20 capitalized interest, ASC 842 leases as they touch project sites). Experience in a SOX-regulated or IPO-readiness environment, or supporting external audits of major capital projects. Exposure to multi-entity, multi-currency structures and cross-border projects. Nordic experience - local statutory reporting alongside US GAAP, and VAT on construction and imports. Experience accounting for high-value technology or compute equipment (GPU, network or telecoms assets), including intra-group equipment leasing. Familiarity with project controls disciplines (cost engineering, earned value, contract administration) and construction contract forms. Experience of ERP and project accounting systems implementation. REQ-156 What We Offer At Volta, we believe people do their best work when they feel supported, trusted and able to grow. We're building a company where you can make an impact, keep a healthy balance between work and life, and build a career you're proud of. As a global team, we do our best to provide great benefits wherever you're based. While some benefits vary by country due to local regulations, we believe looking after our people is simply the right thing to do. Competitive salary based on the work you do here, not your previous salary Equity in Volta, giving you the opportunity to share in the company's long-term success Retirement/pension contributions Comprehensive health, wellbeing and insurance benefits Generous number of vacation days each year Additional Information Background Checks All offers of employment at Volta are conditional on the satisfactory completion of pre-employment screening, which includes confirmation of your right to work, verification of your employment history and a criminal record check, where this is permitted by local law. Screening is carried out by Zinc, an accredited third-party provider, after an offer is made and all information is handled confidentially and in accordance with applicable data protection law. Equal Opportunity Volta is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status or any other legally protected characteristic. Accessibility Volta is committed to providing an accessible recruitment experience for all candidates. If you require accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the application or interview process, please contact us at Candidate Privacy Notice By applying, you consent to the processing of your personal data for recruitment purposes in accordance with applicable data protection laws, including the UK GDPR, EU GDPR and relevant US state privacy regulations. Your data will be shared only with those involved in the hiring process and will not be used for unrelated purposes. For details, see our Recruitment & Candidate Privacy Notice. Note to Recruitment Agencies Volta does not accept unsolicited CVs or candidate profiles from recruitment agencies. Any unsolicited submissions, including those sent directly to hiring managers or employees, will be treated as the property of Volta. No agency fees will be payable unless a valid, signed recruitment agreement is in place, and the agency has been specifically engaged for the relevant vacancy. Contexte :
Vous intégrez le pôle Planning média d'une Business Unit dédiée à des comptes prestigieux dans l’univers du luxe.
Au sein d'une équipe dynamique, vous assurez la gestion et la coordination quotidienne des campagnes médias. Ce poste offre un contact direct et régulier avec des maisons de luxe de premier plan ainsi qu'une dimension internationale affirmée.

Mission : Au quotidien, vous accompagnez les équipes clients dans la construction, le suivi et la mise en œuvre de leurs stratégies média plurimédia, en garantissant une excellence opérationnelle et une communication fluide.

Vos principales missions seront :

Relation Client & Stratégie Média :

  • Assurer le suivi au quotidien des demandes clients et la prise de briefs pour les maisons attribuées.
  • Participer activement à l'élaboration des recommandations et plans médias intégrés en collaboration avec vos managers.
  • Préparer et présenter les recommandations médias aux interlocuteurs clients avec clarté et conviction, en français comme en anglais.

Analyse & Reporting :

  • Réaliser des analyses concurrentielles qualitatives et quantitatives (suivi des investissements média et des stratégies de communication) grâce aux outils du marché.
  • Assurer le suivi opérationnel des campagnes, leur optimisation et la production des reportings en coordination avec les équipes d'activation spécialisées.
  • Élaborer les bilans de campagne et dégager les enseignements clés.

Coordination & Opérations :

  • Assurer la coordination internationale avec nos agences locales et centraliser les échanges pour les clients globaux.
  • Travailler en synergie avec les experts média internes (Digital, Multi-screen, Affichage, Search) et les régies publicitaires.

Gestion Financière & Hygiène de Compte :

  • Créer les devis clients, effectuer le suivi de la facturation et vérifier les bons de commande sous Media Manager.
  • Garantir le respect des process financiers et la parfaite tenue administrative des dossiers.

description: About Abound We’re redefining consumer lending in the UK, and beyond. Using advanced AI and Open Banking data, we make fair, affordable personal finance available to more people. While traditional lenders rely almost entirely on credit scores, we look at the full financial picture - how much you spend, and what you can afford to repay to build a deeper, more accurate understanding of each customer's unique financial situation. And we've shown it works at scale. We’ve issued over £1.3bn in loans directly to customers while delivering market-leading credit performance - for every 10 defaults the industry expects, we see only 3. We also reached profitability just 2.5 years after launch. Backed by £2bn+ of funding from top-tier investors including Citi, GSR Ventures, and Deutsche Bank, we’re recognised as one of Europe’s fastest-growing fintechs (Sifted, CNBC). Now, we’re expanding into new markets and product lines - and we’re looking for ambitious people who want to learn fast, take ownership, and grow with us. The role We are formalising our security assurance function. We have technical controls and the engineering culture; what we need now is the governance layer that proves it - to our auditors, to our funders, and to our regulator. You will be the delivery engine behind that. You will own the recurring assurance cycle end to end, run our third-party security programme, and be the person who turns evidence into something a due diligence team or a certification auditor can be satisfied by. You will be responsible for building controls, gathering evidence, and challenging suppliers. What you will own: 1. Third-party security assurance - Run security due diligence on new suppliers, maintain initial questionnaire to risk sign-off, working with Procurement and Legal on security and data protection schedules. - Maintain a supplier tiering model based on criticality and run the periodic re-assessment cycle for tiered suppliers: certification expiry, subprocessor changes, breach notifications, SLA performance. - Maintain the supplier and outsourcing registers, including preparation for the FCA's material third party register under PS26/2 (rules in force 18 March 2027). - Track concentration risk and exit plans for critical suppliers. 2. Inbound due diligence and customer assurance - Own our response to security due diligence from funders, banking partners, institutional investors, commercial partners and prospects. - Build and maintain a reusable trust pack: answer library, security whitepaper, current certifications, pen test attestations, standard questionnaire pre-fills (SIG, CAIQ). - Turn a 40-hour bespoke questionnaire response into a 4-hour one. 3. The assurance calendar - Maintain the annual calendar of security activities and make sure each one happens, produces evidence, and closes its actions: penetration tests, access reviews, disaster recovery tests, tabletop exercises, policy reviews, supplier re-assessments, awareness training. - Coordinate external penetration tests: scoping, vendor selection, scheduling, findings triage, remediation tracking, retest. - Facilitate tabletop exercises, including scenario design and post-exercise action tracking. 4. Risk and control administration - Maintain the information security risk register: run the assessment cycle, record treatment plans with named owners and dates, chase closure. - Administer the policy exception and risk acceptance process, ensuring every exception is owned, time-bound and reviewed on expiry. - Perform first-line control testing: sample-test where key controls operate as designed and retain the evidence. - Produce security MI for the Head of Security to take to ExCo and the Risk Committee. 5. Vulnerability and findings management - Consolidate findings across sources — EDR, cloud security posture, SAST/DAST/SCA, secrets scanning, penetration tests — into a single view with agreed severity definitions and remediation SLAs. - Triage, route and chase remediation with engineering teams; escalate ageing findings. - Own the reporting on remediation performance. 6. Security awareness - Run the awareness programme: induction, annual refresher, phishing simulation, role-based training for engineers, completion tracking. - Coordinate pre-employment screening with People. What you will contribute to: - The ISO 27001 ISMS, which we are building towards certification. You will draft and maintain control documentation, populate the Statement of Applicability, gather evidence, coordinate the internal audit programme and be a primary point of contact for our external auditor. The Head of Security owns the framework, scope, and risk appetite. - Policies and standards: you will draft, review and shepherd policies through approval, and track the review cycle. - Incident response: you will maintain the IR plan and playbooks, facilitate post-incident reviews, track remediation actions, and support regulatory notification (ICO personal data breach reporting within 72 hours; FCA notification under Principle 11 / SUP 15.3). - Business continuity and DR: you will maintain the documentation and the testing evidence. - Secure development: you will help embed security requirements into the SDLC and support threat modelling sessions. - Data protection: you will support RoPA maintenance, DPIA completion and DSAR handling alongside Legal. What success looks like: First 90 days: you know our supplier estate and have tiered it; the assurance calendar for the next 12 months is published and owned; inbound due diligence requests come to you and go out without the Head of Security rewriting them. Six months: the trust pack exists and is being used; the risk register is live with owned treatment plans; ISO 27001 evidence collection is systematic rather than a scramble; the exception register exists. Twelve months: supplier re-assessment runs on a cadence without prompting; the material third party register is ready ahead of the March 2027 deadline; MI to the Risk Committee is trusted. Essential experience: - Three or more years in an information security assurance, GRC or security compliance role, at least some of it in a regulated financial services environment or another environment with real external audit pressure. - Hands-on experience of ISO 27001, whether operating an ISMS or taking one through certification. - Demonstrable experience running third-party or vendor security assessments, and of responding to inbound security due diligence. - Comfortable reading technical findings — an EDR vulnerability report, a penetration test finding, a cloud misconfiguration — and forming your own view on severity and real-world exploitability rather than passing the vendor's rating through unchanged. - Clear, concise written English. Much of this role is writing things that external parties will judge us on. - The confidence to chase a busy engineer, challenge a supplier's assertion, and tell us when an answer is not good enough. Desirable: - Experience of a cloud-native environment, ideally AWS. - Experience of scaling a control framework as an organisation grows. - Familiarity with UK operational resilience expectations (SYSC 15A) and outsourcing requirements (SYSC 8). - Certifications such as CISM, CISA, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor, CRISC or CCSP. description:
About the role

The Director, HR Technology & Solutions Delivery is a senior technology leadership role responsible for the strategy, design, delivery, operation and evolution of Inizio's global HR technology ecosystem.

In the near term, the role has significant accountability for Workday, leading day-to-day IT operations, functional solution design, enhancements, continuous improvement and strategic HR technology projects.

Over time, the role will evolve HR Technology towards a stronger platform engineering and architecture-led model, establishing the technical strategy, engineering practices, integration architecture, governance, security and operational capabilities required to support Inizio at scale.

This requires a leader who can operate across both the functional and technical dimensions of Workday – translating HR requirements into effective solutions while bringing the technical depth and engineering mindset to shape the future HR technology landscape.

You will have end-to-end IT accountability for Workday and the wider HR technology ecosystem. The Workday IT Operations team will report directly to this role, which reports to the Deputy Chief Information Officer.

 

Responsibilities

Workday Platform, Operations & Functional Design

  • Provide end-to-end IT ownership of Workday, covering functional design, configuration, operations, support, enhancements and continuous improvement.
  • Partner with HR People Services and Centres of Excellence to translate business requirements into scalable, sustainable Workday solutions aligned with global standards.
  • Provide senior oversight of Workday business processes, configuration, security, reporting, integrations and adoption of new platform capabilities.
  • Lead the Workday IT Operations team, ensuring effective management of incidents, requests, defects, changes, enhancements and releases.
  • Establish effective service levels, operational KPIs, demand and backlog management, root-cause analysis, testing, documentation and operational controls.
  • Drive continuous improvement, automation and proactive platform management to improve user experience, reliability and operational efficiency.
  • Act as the senior escalation and decision point for significant Workday functional, technical and operational matters.

 

HR Technology Project & Solutions Delivery

  • HR Technology Strategy: Own end-to-end technology delivery of significant Workday and wider HR technology initiatives, from requirements and solution design through build, integration, testing, deployment, stabilisation and BAU transition.
  • Lead Workday enhancements, module implementations, optimisation initiatives and HR transformation projects.
  • Ensure solutions align with business outcomes, architecture principles and the longer-term HR technology roadmap.
  • Establish delivery governance across scope, plans, dependencies, resources, risks, quality and budget.
  • Hold systems integrators and delivery partners accountable for delivery, solution quality, knowledge transfer and sustainable support.

 

Architecture & Engineering

  • Define the technology strategy, target architecture and multi-year roadmap for Inizio's global HR technology ecosystem.
  • Establish architecture and engineering principles across platforms, integrations, APIs, data, identity, security, environments, testing, deployment, monitoring and operational resilience.
  • Lead the progressive evolution of HR Technology towards a stronger platform engineering operating model, increasing automation, standardisation and engineering discipline.
  • Ensure HR technology is scalable, secure, resilient, maintainable and aligned with Inizio's wider enterprise technology strategy.
  • Manage technical debt and identify opportunities to simplify and modernise the HR technology estate.
  • Develop internal technical capability and reduce unnecessary reliance on external partners for core platform knowledge.

 

Integrations, Security & Technical Governance

  • Own technical governance across HR technology architecture, integrations, security and change.

You'll have the opportunity to become one of the most modern Sales professionals in the market! ⭐ You will be a great fit for this role if you: Have 1-2 years of experience in a Sales role including closing experience Have full working proficiency in French (C2 and above), and advanced level in English Are highly organized with exceptional follow-up skills Show a great balance between Active Listening and Assertiveness when interacting with your prospects Have natural empathy and are passionate about understanding and solving prospects' problems Have a positive attitude and ability to collaborate in a small team Have a desire to learn fast and make an impact from day 1 Are based in (or willing to relocate to) Paris, Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz. For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the A2-B1 level range. Everything else is a plus. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time with co-workers. Therefore, we offer: Fair rewards. Generous equity packages complement your base salary, for permanent contracts only. Flexible office with hybrid setup. Amazing office space at our Paris HQ or sponsored co-working hubs in Bordeaux, Marseille, Lyon, Annecy, Nantes or Biarritz. All the tools you need. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Air, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and Bose noise-canceling headphones. Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish. Delightful healthcare insurance: Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only). Transport. Generous transit benefit Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises. Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential. Learn more about our coaching culture. Parental leave. Extended parental leave for all new parents, for permanent contracts only. Important note: we hire people not roles.
