description: 1- ENVIRONNEMENT DU POSTE Grande école d’ingénieur généraliste de l’IMT-Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs de France, IMT Atlantique a pour ambition d’accompagner les transitions, de former des ingénieurs responsables et mettre l'excellence scientifique et technique au service de l'enseignement, de la recherche et de l'innovation. Le poste est rattaché au Département interdisciplinaire en sciences sociales (DI2S) rassemblant des enseignants chercheurs et enseignantes chercheuses en sciences de gestion, sociologie, économie et droit. Sur le campus de Nantes, les recherches sont focalisées sur l’analyse des transformations des organisations et des métiers dans des systèmes sociotechniques. Trois domaines d’investigation sont privilégiés : l’industrie, la santé et l’environnement. Le ou la candidate sera affilé·e au LEMNA (Laboratoire Économie et Management Nantes Atlantique). Plus précisément, le poste sera rattaché à la chaire RESOH [Recherche en Sécurité Organisations Hommes]. Les travaux de recherche, à l’interface de la sociologie et de la gestion, portent sur le fonctionnement des organisations à hauts risques. Partant de l’analyse du travail et des organisations de travail, il s’agit d’éclairer les dimensions socio-organisationnelles, managériales et institutionnelles contribuant à (ou empêchant) le maintien d’un niveau de fiabilité compatible avec les exigences de sécurité et de production. Les recherches de la chaire sont conduites en étroite collaboration avec des partenaires industriels et institutionnels. Elles visent à produire des connaissances scientifiques fondées sur des enquêtes de terrain, mais également à favoriser leur mise en discussion, leur appropriation et leur mobilisation par les acteurs concernés. Dans ce contexte, la chaire souhaite renforcer ses capacités de valorisation, de diffusion et d’appropriation de ses travaux, auprès de ses partenaires actuels comme, plus largement, du monde socio-économique. 2- MISSIONS En collaboration avec l’ensemble des enseignants-chercheurs de l’équipe (permanents et associés), les missions sont : 1- Participer à la dynamique collective de recherche au sein de la chaire 2- Structurer et valoriser les résultats des recherches de la chaire 3- En favoriser l’appropriation par les partenaires industriels et institutionnels de la chaire (volet interne) 4- Contribuer au rayonnement de la chaire auprès du monde socio-économique (volet externe) 3- ACTIVITÉS : Activité par mission Participer à la dynamique collective de recherche au sein de la chaire · contribue activement aux réunions de coordination, espaces de discussion et séminaires de recherche (au sein de l’équipe de recherche RESOH et avec les partenaires) 2. Valoriser et diffuser les résultats des recherches de la chaire · cartographie les principaux travaux, résultats et productions de la chaire ; · identifie les publics susceptibles d’être intéressés par ces résultats ; · analyse leurs besoins et leurs attentes ; · contribue à définir des stratégies de valorisation et de communication adaptées aux différents projets ; · contribue à l’organisation des événements scientifiques (journée d’étude, colloque, etc.) ; · transforme les résultats scientifiques en ressources accessibles à des publics non spécialistes, sans en perdre la rigueur, la nuance ni la portée scientifique (synthèses, notes de recherche, fiches thématiques, supports de présentation, contenus numériques ou autres formats adaptés aux publics visés). 3. Favoriser l’appropriation des travaux de recherche par les partenaires industriels et institutionnels de la chaire (volet interne) · prépare et organise des restitutions de travaux ; · conçoit et anime des ateliers ou temps d’échange ; · prépare des supports adaptés aux préoccupations des partenaires ; · recueille leurs réactions, questions et besoins ; · fait remonter vers les chercheurs les questions et attentes exprimées par les partenaires ; · contribue à identifier les conditions favorisant l’appropriation des résultats. 4. Contribuer au rayonnement de la chaire auprès du monde socio-économique (volet externe) · identifie des organisations, réseaux et acteurs susceptibles d’être intéressés par les travaux de la chaire ; · développe et entretient des relations avec des acteurs industriels, institutionnels et professionnels ; · identifie des événements pertinents ; · prépare la participation de la chaire à des événements professionnels et scientifiques ; · participe à l’organisation d’événements scientifiques de la chaire (colloque, conférence, journée d’étude) · contribue à développer de nouveaux formats de rencontre entre chercheurs et praticiens ; · participe à la constitution de communautés d’intérêt autour de certaines thématiques de recherche. Niveau de formation et/ou expérience minimums souhaité : · Doctorat · Diplôme Bac + 5 ou équivalent · Diplôme Bac + 4 ou équivalent avec expérience professionnelle ≥ 4 ans Notamment dans les domaines suivants : · sociologie ; · sciences de gestion ; · science politique ; · sciences de l’information et de la communication ; · médiation ou communication scientifique ; · valorisation et transfert des connaissances. Compétences, connaissances et expériences souhaitables : · Une bonne compréhension du fonctionnement de la recherche académique · capacité à comprendre rapidement des travaux scientifiques complexes ; · capacité à identifier et synthétiser les principaux résultats d'une recherche : · aptitude à dialoguer avec des scientifiques et à respecter les exigences de rigueur scientifique. Une expérience dans un ou plusieurs des domaines suivants appréciée : · valorisation ou diffusion de résultats de recherche ; · médiation ou communication scientifique ; · transfert ou circulation des connaissances ; · relations entre recherche et monde socio-économique ; · gestion de projets de recherche ; · animation de réseaux de partenaires ; · organisation d’événements scientifiques ou professionnels ; · conseil ou accompagnement des organisations et des transformations. Capacités et aptitudes : Valorisation et communication Excellentes qualités rédactionnelles ; Très bonnes capacités d’analyse et de synthèse Capacité à adapter un contenu scientifique à différents publics Aptitude à concevoir des supports de diffusion variés Maîtrise des outils numériques et bureautiques Relations partenariales Très bonnes qualités relationnelles Capacité à dialoguer avec des interlocuteurs aux cultures professionnelles différentes Goût pour les fonctions d’interface Capacité à créer et entretenir un réseau professionnel Aptitude à animer des réunions, ateliers et temps d’échange Gestion de projet Autonomie et sens de l’initiative Capacité à gérer plusieurs activités en parallèle Aptitude à planifier et coordonner des actions Capacité à respecter des échéances et à produire des bilans Les candidatures de personnes issues de la recherche, de la valorisation et du transfert de connaissances, de la médiation scientifique, de la communication scientifique ou du conseil en organisation sont encouragées. Early on, that means landing the few people who set the foundation. Later, it means scaling fast without lowering the bar. description: About Mistral Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms. We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited. The Role Cybersecurity is one of the areas where AI could do the most good — and one where the capability must be built with particular care. As a Research Engineer on this track, you'll push our models' capabilities in vulnerability discovery and remediation, security analysis, incident response, and across the offensive-to-defensive spectrum of cybersecurity, and it will be your job to develop that ability deliberately and safely. The work sits at the meeting point of research and engineering: you'll devise new approaches and be the one to implement them. Concretely, that means designing and building RL environments that reproduce realistic security scenarios, pipelines that generate synthetic training instances at scale, and experiments and evaluations that show what our models can actually do. Your results feed directly into the production training runs that shape our frontier models, in close collaboration with Mistral's researchers, engineers, and security specialists. Security specialists and ML engineers are both welcome here — what matters is that you can hold your own in both worlds, and are eager to go deeper on the one you know less. What You Will Do Design and implement RL environments simulating cybersecurity scenarios. Build the pipelines and infrastructure that generate synthetic cybersecurity training instances at scale — thousands of scenarios, not one hand-crafted exercise. Conduct experiments and evaluations of model capabilities on these environments, from quick prototypes to controlled benchmark runs. Own the infrastructure behind the environments: containers, sandboxes, VMs, cloud deployments, and orchestration (Kubernetes), all managed as code. AI-Native Workflow: You use Claude and similar AI tools daily, not occasionally, to plan, build, debug, and document your pipelines, treating AI as a core part of the job rather than an add-on. Version Control & Worktrees: You integrate AI directly into your version control workflow, using Git worktrees (or an equivalent) to run several AI-assisted branches of work side by side, rather than treating AI and your codebase as separate. Context & Memory Management: You maintain structured project context for your AI tools, for example a CLAUDE.md-style instructions file, so they stay accurate and useful as pipelines and codebases grow, rather than relying on ad hoc prompts each time. Parallel Agentic Work: You run multiple AI coding agents on separate tickets at the same time where it makes sense, reviewing and integrating their output rather than writing every line serially yourself. AI-Assisted Communication: You're comfortable using AI to help manage day-to-day coordination, including in Slack, when it's the faster and more reliable way to keep things moving. Cross-Functional Collaboration: You move fluidly across data engineering, machine learning, data science, and analytics work, depending on where the team needs you most, rather than staying fixed in one discipline. Staying Ahead: You stay updated with industry best practices and emerging technologies in data engineering and applied AI, bringing new ideas and approaches to the team. What You Bring Technical Foundation: You have a degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Data Science, or a related field, or bootcamp experience, with a minimum of 4 years of professional experience across data engineering, machine learning, data science, or analytics. Current, Deep Databricks Experience: You are proficient in designing, implementing, and optimizing ETL processes on Databricks, with at least a year of current, hands-on depth, not brief or dated exposure. Tools & Technologies: You have hands-on experience with Databricks and AWS services such as S3, Kinesis, and Lambda or similar technologies. Experience with GitLab CI/CD pipelines and familiarity with PostgreSQL are a plus. Genuine AI Fluency: You use AI tools like Claude hands-on, daily, across planning, building, debugging, and documentation, not just for occasional testing. This is a core, non-negotiable part of the role, not a nice-to-have. Context Engineering: You know how to set up and maintain project context and memory for AI coding tools, structured instructions and reusable prompts, so they stay effective as a codebase grows rather than relying on default settings. Agentic & Worktree Fluency: You're comfortable running several tickets in parallel with AI assistance, using Git worktrees or a similar approach to keep parallel AI-assisted branches isolated and reviewable, and you can explain your actual workflow in detail rather than describing it as something that just happens automatically. Programming Skills: You are highly proficient in Python, SQL, and PySpark for data manipulation and processing, and you write clean, maintainable, production-ready code. Mindset & Communication: You have excellent problem-solving skills, strong attention to detail, and the ability to work independently and collaboratively. You are fluent in English, both verbally and in writing, comfortable letting AI take on a meaningful share of day-to-day coordination, and genuinely open to a way of working where AI reshapes how data teams operate, not just tolerant of it. How We Win Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford. Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail. See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. “Not my job” isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved. Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes. Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. Work with HelloFresh in Berlin and its HelloTech organisation, HelloFresh’s global technology backbone with more than 1000 people, building the digital products that power our end-to-end food experience. From meal kits and ready-to-eat meals to specialty offerings like pet food and premium meat & seafood, HelloTech creates the platforms that bring tailored food solutions to millions of customers every month.

Our subscription-based, direct-to-consumer model relies on technology at every step, from customer-facing apps and personalization logic to pricing, forecasting, supply chain optimization, and initiatives that help reduce food waste. While our brands operate independently to serve distinct customer needs, they are united by shared platforms, data, and operational excellence built by HelloTech.

HelloTech works in autonomous, cross-functional alliances, each owning a specific product or domain end to end. By working with our Warsaw office, you will help shape scalable, data-driven products used across our markets, working with a modern tech stack and international teams to continuously improve how people discover, order, and enjoy HelloFresh’s products, today and in the future.

The role

As a Senior Data Analyst at HelloFresh, you will anchor the data strategy driving our aggressive, automation-first transformation. Our Global Customer Experience (GCX) team’s mission is to understand our customers’ journeys and empower market leads with insights and intelligent solutions that improve satisfaction, retention, and efficiency. We are moving fast to scale our self-serve rate, achieve 100% chatbot coverage, improve CSAT, and launch real-time, proactive incident communications via in-app CRM channels.

We need a strategic thought partner for our Product, Engineering, and CX Automation teams who brings a high bar of technical rigor. In this role, you will own our core automation analytics architecture (chatbots, voicebots, agent-assist AI, and customer self-reporting tools), dive deep into GenAI conversational landscapes, and translate complex log data into actionable roadmap strategies. If you love solving open-ended problems and want to directly shape the experience of millions of global customers, you might just be our missing ingredient.

What you’ll do

  • Anchor the data strategy for our entire automation and chatbot analytics infrastructure, serving as the sole embedded analytics lead within the Global CX department.
  • Proactively monitor user intents and trends to diagnose system bugs early and establish standardized, organization-wide KPIs for bot containment and NLP accuracy.
  • Conduct deep-dive analyses of chat transcripts and user journeys, leveraging semantic clustering and LLM evaluation to uncover friction points and tune conversational flows.
  • Continuously optimize and secure our reporting environment, ensuring data integrity, normalization, and advanced visualization techniques for critical executive decision-making.
  • Partner closely with cross-functional teams (Product, Engineering, and CX Automation) to translate complex customer log data and system requirements into sustainable roadmap strategies.
  • Own and deliver core business reporting mechanisms and dashboards, including the Monthly Business Review (MBR) and EBIT reviews.

What you’ll bring

  • A passion for driving automation-first transformations and solving complex operational problems within a fast-paced customer experience environment.
  • Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL to handle increased domain complexity and secure our underlying reporting architecture.
  • Experience with next-gen agentic workflow stacks (e.g., Claude Code, Cursor) to optimize development and analytical speed.
  • Proven track record of designing, implementing, and maintaining high-visibility BI solutions and dashboards that communicate trends clearly to Directors, VPs, and SVPs.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to lead complex data analytics projects and influence cross-functional partner

What we offer: The Toppings

  • Global collaboration at scale: Collaborate with experienced engineers and product partners across HelloTech’s international teams, in a culture of active knowledge sharing.

description: About Genesis We are a full-stack general-purpose robot company, born across San Francisco, London and Paris and bound by a single mission: to make general-purpose robots a reality, unlocking infinite physical labor for the world and freeing people for creativity, exploration and the pursuits they love for their own sake. We're building the engine that will teach robots to do real work in the real world. We recently unveiled Eno, our wheeled, dexterous robot powered by our GENE foundation model and we are starting to put it to work with real customers. The role General-purpose robots learn from real, dexterous human work, the kind of data that does not exist on the internet. We capture it with our own collection hardware: a person wears it, does the work, and the robot learns to do it too. You will be a senior member of the team scaling our data collection operation in Paris, working closely with our Paris research and engineering teams and with the operation in the Bay Area. You will help lead the day-to-day execution and quality bar on the Paris floor while remaining deeply hands-on with data collection, teleoperation, task setup, and real-robot testing. You will wear our gloves and cameras, teleoperate our hardware, and take ownership of complex collection requests from setup through execution and quality review. You will work shoulder to shoulder with our model engineering and research teams, turning their requests into physical demonstrations and feeding what you learn on the floor back to them. You will be expected to operate autonomously, help guide and train other operators and contribute to how the Paris operation evolves as the team grows. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will not just run existing tasks: you will help shape how they are executed, how quality is measured, and how other operators are trained to deliver consistently. Create high-quality training data. Wear our gloves and cameras, teleoperate our hardware, and produce precise demonstrations that can be used to train our models. Own the full collection workflow. Go beyond collecting the data itself: review and quality-check your work, identify unusable episodes, support annotation, and help ensure that what reaches research is trainable data. Build repeatable tasks. Turn new collection requests into clear, repeatable processes that can be executed consistently by other operators. Partner with research and model engineering. Translate their requests into physical collection tasks, share observations from the floor, and iterate with them on setups and collection strategy. Improve the operation. Identify when a fixture, station layout, procedure, or collection method can be improved and proactively help implement those improvements. Write and improve the playbook. Own SOPs, quality checks, and training materials that allow the Paris operation to scale while maintaining a consistent quality bar. Guide other operators. Help onboard, train, and mentor operators and reinforce consistent execution across the team. Run real-robot testing. Partner with reliability and engineering teams to test robots on the floor, document what you observe, and help surface issues. Own quality. Review your own work and the team's, take direct feedback, and keep raising the bar. What we are looking for You have done precise, repetitive physical work to a high quality bar and can explain what made your work good and how you measured it. This could include data collection, teleoperation, motion capture, robotics lab work, assembly, fine craft, or another hands-on technical environment. Hands-on robot or glove-based data collection experience is a strong plus, but not a requirement. This kind of data collection is new, and we will teach you our specific tools and approach. You build, not just run. Give you a vague request and a scrappy setup, and you can turn it into a clean, repeatable task with the right fixtures, environment, process, and written procedure. You can operate autonomously. You are comfortable taking ownership of complex collection tasks with limited day-to-day support from engineering. You understand quality beyond collection. You can review your work, recognize when collected data is unusable or below the quality bar, and understand why. You are ready to lead. You have trained, mentored, or led others doing hands-on work and want to help establish the execution and quality standard for a growing team. You work well with research and engineering teams. You can translate their requests into physical collection tasks and turn what you observe during collection into useful feedback. You have exceptional attention to detail. You notice the moment something about the setup, hardware, environment, procedure, or collected data is off. You are technically handy. You are comfortable with Linux, some Python scripting to automate repetitive work, and hardware assembly and troubleshooting. You are comfortable in a fast-moving environment. Hardware, processes, and collection methods will evolve quickly, and you are comfortable adapting while helping improve how the team works. You communicate well in English. You will work daily with teams in Paris and the Bay Area across time zones. French is a plus. Bonus: reliability testing. You have partnered with a reliability or test team on real-robot testing. Working conditions and role constraints Work takes place in production environments and technical laboratories. Prolonged standing and repetitive hand and arm movements while wearing collection equipment, including gloves, head-mounted cameras, and headsets, for extended periods. Handling and lifting of loads, including props, fixtures, robot equipment, and station equipment, up to 23 kg for station setup and reconfiguration. Why this role Real ownership. You will have meaningful ownership over how the Paris data collection floor operates and help set the standard the team grows toward. Hands-on leadership. You will remain close to the work while helping guide other operators, improve execution, and raise the quality bar. Build, not just execute. You will take ambiguous collection needs and turn them into reliable, repeatable tasks that can scale across the team. A clear growth path. As the operation scales, this role can grow toward leading or supervising teams of operators or toward broader project and program management responsibilities. The front line of the mission. description:
About Decathlon

Decathlon aims to become the best sports digital platform and open ecosystem in the world. We want to enable customers to experience Decathlon through many local sport-centric experiences by connecting many third-party actors and services, in a secure and performant way.

Our digital teams bring together more than 5000 collaborators are united to build and scale digital products with the aim to always deliver the best value to our users. With a presence in more than 70 countries, Decathlon is committed to innovation, sustainability, and customer satisfaction.

Job Description

Decathlon is seeking a talented and experienced Data Scientist to join our Demand and Assortment Planning team within the Supply Chain department. As a Senior Data Scientist, you will play a critical role in developing AI models into production and providing insights/recommendations to optimise demand forecasting and assortment planning processes. We welcome candidates with expertise in time series forecasting and a passion for leveraging data to drive business decisions.

Responsibilities

  • Analyse and study historical sales data and market trends to forecast demand for Decathlon products.
  • Develop and implement advanced statistical models and machine learning algorithms for demand forecasting and assortment planning, including foundation models. 
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Supply Chain Business, Engineering, and Product Development to align Data and AI efforts with business objectives.
  • Evaluate and improve existing forecasting models and methodologies to enhance accuracy and efficiency.
  • Communicate insights and recommendations to stakeholders through clear and concise data visualisations and presentations.
  • Stay updated on industry trends and emerging technologies in data science and supply chain management.

Hard Skills

  • Proficiency in statistical analysis, forecasting, machine learning techniques, time series, time series foundation models and time series analysis (stationarity, decomposition, drift, anomaly detection).
  • Experience with programming languages such as Python, Spark, TensorFlow, Pytorch for data analysis and modelling.
  • Strong knowledge of data manipulation and visualisation tools such as pandas, NumPy, Matplotlib, or ggplot2.
  • Familiarity with database systems and querying languages (e.g., SQL, PySpark) for data extraction and manipulation.
  • Experience with demand forecasting and inventory optimisation software/tools is a plus.
  • Experience with Generative AI is a plus.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities with a keen attention to detail.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively in cross-functional teams.

description:
Senior Motion Designer 2D/3D (m/f/x) 

Brand Marketing · Berlin 

At HelloFresh Group, our mission is to change the way people eat forever. Since our 2011 founding in Berlin, we've become the global market leader in the meal kit sector, inspiring millions of home cooks and food lovers every week. Our portfolio spans eight brands across 16 markets, from HelloFresh and Factor to Good Chop and Pets Table. 

ABOUT THE ROLE 

We are looking for a Senior Motion Designer who balances high-level craft with systems-level thinking. This isn't a role for templated content churn; it’s about setting a high creative bar and building the frameworks that keep that quality intact at high volume, particularly across Paid Social. You will use AI tools to accelerate production, keeping human creativity at the center of every decision. 

Based in our Berlin studio as part of the Global Brand Team, you will report to the Video Creative Lead. You’ll act as their key partner in translating brand storytelling into motion — owning the creative process from inception to final cut while evolving our motion design system across global markets. 

We value diverse backgrounds and non-linear skill development. If you feel aligned with this mission, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single bullet point. 

WHAT YOU’LL DO 

Own the craft. Concept, storyboard, design, and animate 2D and 3D motion assets across TV, Digital OOH, Paid Social, and YouTube. 

Scale Brand Systems: Evolve and maintain our global motion design guidelines. Build reusable project templates, workflows, and asset libraries that internal designers and external agencies can seamlessly execute against. 

Integrate AI Thoughtfully: Leverage modern AI tools (e.g., Runway, Midjourney) to optimize production speed without compromising brand aesthetic or creative standards. 

Collaborate & Mentor: Partner with creative and brand leads to present work to stakeholders, while guiding junior designers and freelancers to raise overall craft quality. 

Obsess over details: Execute precise timing, easing, pacing, and basic sound design. Master the invisible stuff that separates ok motion from unforgettable motion.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR 

  • Experience: 5+ years of dedicated motion design experience with a strong portfolio demonstrating excellence in both 2D and 3D execution. 
  • Systems Mindset: Proven ability to build production pipelines, style frameworks, and scalable workflows for high-volume content environments. 
  • Technical Toolkit: Advanced proficiency in After Effects, Cinema 4D, Blender, Figma, and the broader Adobe Creative Cloud suite. 
  • Emerging Tech Proficiency: Hands-on experience integrating AI-assisted animation, editing, or image-generation tools into creative workflows. 
  • Conceptual & Nuanced Craft: Exceptional eye for rhythm and pacing, strong sensitivity to brand context, and the communication skills to navigate stakeholder feedback effectively. 
  • Solid brand experience. You've applied and evolved brand systems before, not just made pretty one-off videos. 
  • Meticulous Craft & Sensitivity: Uncompromising taste and attention to detail (from timing and easing to brand nuance and context) backed by the emotional intelligence to navigate feedback and read both a brief and a room well. 

Nice to Have: 

  • Experience in sound design or an intuitive musical sense for pacing and rhythm. ● Prior experience working within the food, D2C, or tech sectors. 

Please submit your application along with a portfolio or showreel highlighting your 2D/3D capabilities, above-the-line campaigns (TV/DOOH), and digital channel assets (Paid Social/YouTube).

description:
PsiQuantum’s mission is to build the first useful quantum computers—machines capable of delivering the breakthroughs the field has long promised. Since our founding in 2016, our singular focus has been to build and deploy million-qubit, fault-tolerant quantum systems. 

Quantum computers harness the laws of quantum mechanics to solve problems that even the most advanced supercomputers or AI systems will never reach. Their impact will span energy, pharmaceuticals, finance, agriculture, transportation, materials, and other foundational industries. 

Our architecture and approach is based on silicon photonics. By leveraging the advanced semiconductor manufacturing industry—including partners like GlobalFoundries—we use the same high-volume processes that already produce billions of chips for telecom and consumer electronics. Photonics offers natural advantages for scale: photons don’t feel heat, are immune to electromagnetic interference, and integrate with existing cryogenic cooling and standard fiber-optic infrastructure. 

In 2024, PsiQuantum announced government-funded projects to support the build-out of our first utility-scale quantum computers in Brisbane, Australia, and Chicago, Illinois. These initiatives reflect a growing recognition that quantum computing will be strategically and economically defining—and that now is the time to scale. 

PsiQuantum also develops the algorithms and software needed to make these systems commercially valuable. Our application, software, and industry teams work directly with leading Fortune 500 companies—including Lockheed Martin, Mercedes-Benz, Boehringer Ingelheim, and Mitsubishi Chemical—to prepare quantum solutions for real-world impact. 

Quantum computing is not an extension of classical computing. It represents a fundamental shift—and a path to mastering challenges that cannot be solved any other way. The potential is enormous, and we have a clear path to make it real. 

Come join us.

The Senior Optical Packaging Engineer is responsible for developing & implementing high-performance, robust & scalable opto-electronic packaging workflows for a variety of chip-based photonic integrated circuits.   • Work with our internal packaging team and external vendors on transferring & scaling packaging designs and processes based on successful prototypes.
  • Work with external vendors and suppliers to source required materials and provide feedback on evolving requirements. 
  • Working with external partners to develop advanced opto-electronic packaging solutions.

  • Experience with optical data analysis.

description: ABOUT US tozero is Europe’s leading deep-tech startup specializing in the recycling of lithium-ion batteries. Committed to accelerating decarbonization and transforming the material life cycle, we’re actively crafting sustainable recycling solutions for a cleaner and more innovative future. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR We are looking for a Senior Process Engineer to take a leading technical role in the design, scale-up, commissioning and ramp up of our battery recycling processes. This role sits at the intersection of technology development, process engineering, and industrial scale-up. You will translate experimental and operational data into robust process designs, challenge engineering assumptions, and ensure that our future plants are built on solid fundamentals. Your focus will be on the processes that matter most to our technology — graphite and lithium extraction. By working closely with R&D, Operations and external engineering partners, you will actively lead and engage in activities associated with: a) engineering design; b) commissioning and ramp up; c) process development. We are looking for someone who is comfortable working in a production environment, but who can also take a step back and understand what the data is telling us, and engineer the process we need at different scales. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Must Have's: 1. Future Plant Design & Scale-up ● Own key process design activities for our next-generation plants. ● Develop and review PFDs, P&IDs, mass and energy balances, process descriptions and equipment specifications for future capacity expansions. ● Translate pilot and industrial operating data into reliable engineering design criteria and scale-up assumptions. ● Perform process calculations and equipment sizing to ensure our future plants are designed based on validated engineering data rather than theoretical assumptions alone. 2. Targeted Process Expertise & Optimization ● Become a technical reference for some of our most critical process steps. ● Apply strong chemical engineering fundamentals to the optimization of graphite and lithium extraction and post-processing. ● Identify the parameters controlling yield, purity and process stability and translate these insights into concrete process improvements. ● Work closely with R&D and Operations while maintaining a strong focus on process performance and technology development rather than daily troubleshooting. 3. Data Analysis & Process Modeling ● Turn plant data into engineering decisions. ● Evaluate operational and experimental data, build and validate mass balances and process models, and identify gaps between expected and actual process performance. ● Define what data needs to be collected to support future scale-up decisions. ● Technically guide data analysts and other engineering functions to ensure that models and analytics remain grounded in physical and chemical reality. ● Translate analysis into clear recommendations for process upgrades and future plant designs. 4. Commissioning & Process Validation ● Make sure what we designed actually works. ● Participate in FATs/SATs, commissioning activities and process performance validation for new equipment and plant expansions. ● Develop acceptance and process validation criteria based on the original design intent. ● Evaluate commissioning and operational data to confirm that installed systems achieve their calculated performance targets. ● Work closely with Operations during handover while ensuring clear ownership transfers once the process meets its design criteria. 5. Our Global Structure


Deliveroo is now part of DoorDash, bringing together teams with even greater reach, scale, and ambition. Depending on your role, you may collaborate with teammates, systems, and leaders across DoorDash and Wolt. Together, we’re unlocking new possibilities as one global team.

About the team

Engineering the future of customer support — at global scale 🌍

We believe exceptional customer service is more than just a feature, it’s a fundamental part of who we are. That’s why we’ve built our own internal support tooling from the ground up, tailored to help our customer, courier, and merchant support teams shine in every interaction.

As we scale our operations from 30 to 60 countries, supporting millions of users and partners, our internal tools need to scale with us. The Support Engineering group is at the heart of this mission. We build high-performance admin applications and core operational tools that empower our support teams to work smarter and faster. A key part of this is our in-house chat platform, which already handles around 5 million conversations every month. On top of this foundation, we’re developing advanced features to reduce manual work, improve communication, and proactively resolve issues — often before our users even notice them.

Our systems range from automated reach-outs for delayed orders to deeply integrated tools that enable our support teams to deliver assistance quickly, reliably, and with a human touch. By removing inefficiencies and automating repetitive tasks, we’re ensuring that our users and partners receive world-class support at scale.

 

About the role

We’re now looking for a Senior Backend Engineer (Golang) to join us in building scalable, low-latency systems that power these tools and shape the future of customer support. You’ll work on impactful products that directly influence how millions of people experience our platform every day.

What you'll be doing

  • Build and maintain high-throughput backend services using Go.

  • Collaborate with product managers, designers, and frontend developers to ship features that support internal support agents across the globe.

  • Design systems that are scalable, resilient, and easy to maintain.

  • Lead and contribute to architectural discussions and technical decision-making.

  • Write well-tested code and help the team maintain high code quality standards.

Requirements

  • 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a proven track record of building and scaling complex systems.

  • 2+ years of production experience in Golang, with the ability to mentor others and drive best practices across the team.

  • Strong hands-on experience with both SQL and NoSQL databases — especially Cassandra.

  • Solid understanding of designing and operating low-latency, high-throughput distributed systems.

  • Previous on-call experience, with a pragmatic approach to reliability and incident management.

Nice to have

  • Background in Node.js or other backend languages.

  • Familiarity with cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP) and event-driven architectures.

Why Deliveroo

Our mission is to transform the way you shop and eat, bringing the neighbourhood to your door by connecting consumers, restaurants, shops and riders. We are transforming the way the world eats and shops by making access to food and products more convenient and enjoyable. We give people the opportunity to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

We are a technology-driven company at the forefront of the most rapidly expanding industry in the world. We are still a small team, making a very large impact, looking to answer some of the most interesting questions out there. We move fast, value autonomy and ownership, and we are always looking for new ideas.

Workplace & Benefits

At Deliveroo we know that people are the heart of the business and we prioritise their welfare. Benefits differ by country, but we offer many benefits in areas including healthcare, well-being, parental leave, pensions, and generous annual leave allowances, including time off to support a charitable cause of your choice. Benefits are country-specific, please ask your recruiter for more information.

Diversity

At Deliveroo, we believe a great workplace is one that represents the world we live in and how beautifully diverse it can be. That means we have no judgement when it comes to any one of the things that make you who you are - your gender, race, sexuality, religion or a secret aversion to coriander. All you need is a passion for (most) food and a desire to be part of one of the fastest-growing businesses in a rapidly growing industry.

We are committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in all aspects of our hiring process. We recognise that some candidates may require adjustments to apply for a position or fairly participate in the interview process. If you require any adjustments, please don't hesitate to let us know. We will make every effort to provide the necessary adjustments to ensure you have an equitable opportunity to succeed.

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion

At Deliveroo, we know that a great workplace reflects the world around us and that true diversity and inclusion make us stronger, more creative, and better at what we do. We’re committed to fostering an environment where everyone can do their best work and feel they belong.

We believe in equality of opportunity and welcome candidates from all backgrounds regardless of age, gender, ethnicity, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, socio-economic background, religion, or belief.

If you have a disability or long-term health condition and need support to apply for one of our roles, or require any reasonable adjustments during the recruitment process, you’ll have the opportunity to let us know once you’ve submitted your application. We’ll share details on how to request support so we can ensure you have a fair and equitable experience.

If you’re excited about making a real impact in a fast-moving marketplace and growing your career alongside ambitious, supportive teams, we’d love to hear from you!


Beware of recruitment scams: DASH Brands will never ask you to pay money or share sensitive financial information during hiring — learn more about DASH Brands' legitimate recruiting process at careersatdoordash.com/recruitment-scam-awareness.

description: Your Mission This is a company built for growth. When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone. You'll work on real systems at a big scale, building high-performing consumer products used by millions. We move fast, cut the noise, and focus on what actually matters, because in our industry, speed wins. We're rapidly scaling one of the most exciting innovations in mobile gaming: a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps publishers acquire and retain players through rewarding experiences. Our products are data-driven by design, powered by event-driven architectures, complex business logic, and quick feedback loops, with decisions informed by data and experimentation, not gut feeling. As Senior Technical Product Manager (f/m/x), this role isn't just about shipping features, it's about building products that perform. Product at exmox means understanding the bigger technical and business picture, working closely with Engineering, including how we use AI to move faster and cut down on repetitive work, and turning strategy into precise, technically grounded product decisions that create real value. Every change you ship affects millions of users, and that responsibility is what makes working at exmox exciting. If you're energized by fast-moving markets, complex technical systems, and the challenge of building products that perform at scale, we want to hear from you. What You'll Own: Technical product strategy & vision Together with Engineering leads, you shape the product vision, strategy, and roadmap with a clear understanding of technical constraints and opportunities. You define goals and success metrics, and continuously evolve product direction based on system capabilities, technical debt, and business priorities. Discovery, scoping & prioritization You gather and balance inputs from engineering, user research, data, and stakeholders to deeply understand problems, including their technical complexity. You write detailed, unambiguous requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that engineers can act on immediately. Agile ownership & delivery You own the product backlog end-to-end: grooming, refinement, sprint planning, and prioritization. You actively participate in technical discussions, architecture reviews, and sprint ceremonies, ensuring the team always has well-defined, ready-to-build work. Technical stakeholder alignment You translate business needs into precise engineering requirements, and translate technical realities back into language stakeholders understand. You work closely with Engineering, UI/UX, Data, Marketing, and Operations to ensure alignment across the full product lifecycle. Experimentation & continuous improvement You leverage A/B testing, analytics, and system monitoring to validate ideas, measure outcomes, and drive ongoing product and technical improvements. You understand data pipelines and instrumentation well enough to define the right metrics from the ground up. What You Bring Technical Product Manager experience Strong experience as a Technical Product Manager building digital products, ideally in mobile gaming, ad-tech, e-commerce, or online marketing. You've worked closely with engineering teams and are comfortable in technical conversations. Engineering fluency You don't need to code, but you can read and discuss API contracts, system architectures, database schemas, and technical trade-offs. Engineers see you as a peer, not just a requirements writer. Agile ownership You have deep hands-on experience owning a product backlog: writing epics, user stories, and acceptance criteria, running sprint ceremonies, and continuously improving team throughput and focus. Data-driven product decisions Solid experience using quantitative data, A/B testing, funnel analysis, and product analytics tools to guide decisions. You understand how data is collected, structured, and interpreted, and can define instrumentation requirements yourself. High-scale product teams At least 4 years of experience working with cross-functional engineering and product teams on high-scale digital products with millions of users. Discovery & problem solving Strong analytical and structured thinking skills. You can break down complex technical and product problems, identify root causes, and drive toward clear, testable solutions. Ownership mindset You unblock teams, remove ambiguity, and take accountability for outcomes, not just outputs. You're persistent, solution-oriented, and comfortable making calls with incomplete information. Clear communicator across technical and non-technical audiences Outstanding at adapting communication style: precise and detailed with engineers, strategic and impact-focused with leadership and business stakeholders. Structured & organized Able to manage multiple workstreams, balance competing priorities, and deliver against realistic timelines without losing sight of the bigger picture How We Win Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford. Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail. See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved. Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes. Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together. Please note: this is not a remote only position, we offer you a flexible hybrid model here in Hamburg, Germany - working from home on Mondays & Fridays, coming to the office on Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday! About THG Ingenuity

THG Ingenuity is a fully integrated digital commerce ecosystem, designed to power brands without limits. Our global end-to-end tech platform is comprised of three products: THG Commerce, THG Studios, THG Fulfilment. 

Each represents a single, unified solution, overcoming challenges and taking brands direct-to-consumer. Our client portfolio includes globally recognised brands such as Coca-Cola, Nestle, Elemis, Homebase, and Proctor & Gamble.

Team: Search & Social (Commerce Division), THG Ingenuity

Introduction

THG Ingenuity is a leading ecommerce and technology business, powering some of the world's most recognised brands. Our Search & Social team sits within the wider Commerce division, operating at the intersection of ecommerce, marketing, and commercial strategy. Alongside our Content and Paid Media teams, we connect brands with customers through world-class organic and paid search strategies.

We're looking for an ambitious, detail-oriented graduate to join our team and help shape the future of search. This is an excellent opportunity for someone with a passion for SEO to build a career at the forefront of digital marketing, working on Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) and AI-driven search within a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Success in this role requires a deep curiosity for search engine algorithms, strong analytical skills, commercial awareness, and the ability to build positive relationships with internal teams (like eCommerce, Paid Media, and project management) and external brand clients.

The Role

As an SEO & GEO Executive, you will support the planning, execution, optimisation, and reporting of organic search campaigns across multiple brands. You will work to grow organic visibility, traffic, and revenue, ensuring our clients dominate the search engine results pages (SERPs).

You'll work in close partnership with our Paid Media team to ensure our organic and paid search strategies are fully aligned. You'll also collaborate daily with the eCommerce teams who are trading the sites, project teams managing site onboards, and external brand partners, ensuring SEO is a core pillar of our commercial success.

This role combines technical SEO, content strategy, performance analysis, and stakeholder management, providing a well-rounded foundation in the future of search.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support the end-to-end delivery of SEO strategies for multiple brands.
  • Conduct keyword research, content gap analysis, and SERP analysis to identify new growth opportunities.
  • Perform technical SEO audits to identify and fix issues related to site architecture, crawlability, and indexation.
  • Collaborate with content teams to ensure on-page content is optimised for both users and search engines.
  • Analyse and report on organic performance using Google Search Console, GA4, and industry-standard search analytics platforms.
  • Work closely with the Paid Media team to share search query insights, coordinate keyword targeting, and develop a unified search strategy.
  • Support project teams with SEO requirements for site migrations and new client onboards.
  • Stay informed on algorithm updates, competitor activity, and emerging trends, particularly in AI-driven search and GEO.
  • Build strong working relationships with internal stakeholders (eCommerce, Content, Paid Media) and external brand clients.

About You

We're looking for someone who is:

  • A recent graduate with a primary passion for SEO and organic search, and a keen interest in related fields like Paid Media, eCommerce, client services, or digital marketing.
  • Highly organised with strong time management and prioritisation skills.
  • Detail-oriented with exceptionally high standards of accuracy and quality.
  • Commercially aware and interested in how SEO drives business performance.
  • A strong communicator with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Professional, collaborative and able to build positive stakeholder relationships with both internal teams and external clients.
  • Proactive, accountable and comfortable taking ownership of their work.
  • Curious, adaptable and eager to learn about the future of search.

Skills & Experience

Essential

  • A foundational understanding of SEO principles (technical, on-page, and off-page).
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail.
  • Strong written communication skills, including grammar and spelling.
  • Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines effectively.
  • A genuine appetite and eagerness to learn and develop.

Desirable

  • Some hands-on experience with Google Search Console and Google Analytics (GA4).
  • Familiarity with web crawling or search analytics platforms.
  • Understanding of the relationship between SEO and other digital marketing channels like Paid Media, Content, and eCommerce.
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, commercial environment.

description:
At Hudson River Trading (HRT) the Applied AI team’s mission is to increase the speed and quality of work across the firm’s most consequential workflows. We build AI systems that help researchers and developers iterate faster, automate increasingly complex work, and enable autonomous exploration at a scale that would not otherwise be possible.

We apply frontier models and agentic systems to how quantitative research, software development, and other critical work at HRT gets done. We combine cutting-edge commercial and open-source models and tools with infrastructure, research, and systems of our own.

Our work spans the full stack required to make this successful: AI infrastructure, research engineering, post-training and reinforcement learning, agent evaluation, security and alignment, and deployment into real workflows.

Responsibilities

  • Building scalable infrastructure for training, evaluating, and operating language models and AI agents
  • Developing research environments, evaluation systems, and experimentation platforms that allow us to measure and improve agent performance
  • Improving model and agent capabilities through post-training, reinforcement learning, prompting, tool design, and workflow optimization
  • Designing sandboxing, policy enforcement, monitoring, and other safeguards for increasingly capable autonomous systems
  • Partnering with teams across HRT to identify work AI can newly perform, develop effective solutions, and turn successful experiments into durable systems
  • Evaluating new models, techniques, and products, and making informed decisions about when to build, buy, or adapt them
  • Sharing technical knowledge and establishing effective practices for building and working with AI across HRT

Profile

  • You are an excellent engineer who can turn ambiguous problems into working systems
  • You learn unfamiliar technical and business domains quickly and enjoy moving between them
  • You care about advancing what AI systems can reliably accomplish
  • You use rigorous measurement and experiment design to guide decisions
  • You are comfortable operating across research and production engineering
  • You communicate clearly and collaborate well with people from different technical backgrounds
  • You are curious about the capabilities, limitations, and risks of increasingly autonomous systems

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience required
  • Strong Python proficiency required
  • Excellent software design, debugging, and problem-solving skills required
  • Experience building and operating substantial software systems required
  • Demonstrated engagement with modern AI systems, tools, or research required
  • Machine learning research or engineering, including post-training, fine-tuning, reinforcement learning, or alignment
  • AI-agent architecture, evaluation, or tool-use environments
  • Distributed systems, model serving, orchestration, or high-throughput research infrastructure
  • Security sandboxing, policy enforcement, adversarial testing, or governance for AI systems
  • Forward-deployed engineering: working closely with users to discover, build, and operationalize new capabilities
  • Linux, systems performance, networking, C++, or TypeScript

The estimated base salary range for this position is 200,000 to 300,000 USD per year (or local equivalent). The base pay offered may vary depending on multiple individualized factors, including location, job-related knowledge, skills, and experience. This role will also be eligible for discretionary performance-based bonuses and a competitive benefits package.

Culture

Hudson River Trading (HRT) brings a scientific approach to trading financial products. We have built one of the world's most sophisticated computing environments for research and development. Our researchers are at the forefront of innovation in the world of algorithmic trading.

At HRT we welcome a variety of expertise: mathematics and computer science, physics and engineering, media and tech. We’re a community of self-starters who are motivated by the excitement of being at the cutting edge of automation in every part of our organization—from trading, to business operations, to recruiting and beyond. We value openness and transparency, and celebrate great ideas from HRT veterans and new hires alike. At HRT we’re friends and colleagues – whether we are sharing a meal, playing the latest board game, or writing elegant code. We embrace a culture of togetherness that extends far beyond the walls of our office.

Feel like you belong at HRT? Our goal is to find the best people and bring them together to do great work in a place where everyone is valued. HRT is proud of our diverse staff; we have offices all over the globe and benefit from our varied and unique perspectives. HRT is an equal opportunity employer; so whoever you are we’d love to get to know you.

Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry’s digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity.

Every quote Xometry generates in Europe depends on getting two things right at once: an accurate read on manufacturability and a price that wins the job without leaving margin on the table. As Staff Product Manager for Pricing, you will own the strategy and roadmap for how Xometry prices and evaluates manufacturability across the EMEA region — a technical, cross-functional, high-ownership role at the intersection of pricing strategy, manufacturing domain expertise, and applied AI.

How You’ll Contribute:

  • Vision & strategy: Define and drive a multi-year roadmap for pricing and manufacturability in Europe, translating regional market dynamics, competitive positioning, and customer behavior into a pricing strategy that accelerates sales growth without sacrificing margin discipline.
  • Own the Intelligent DFM Workbench: Lead the systems and models that determine how Xometry prices custom parts across European markets — identifying where pricing is too slow, too rigid, or too disconnected from true manufacturability cost, and closing those gaps.
  • Extend Xometry's global AI capabilities into Europe: Partner with global product, data science, and ML engineering teams to adapt and scale Xometry's AI-driven pricing and manufacturability solutions for the European region — geometry-based cost estimation, manufacturability scoring, and pricing optimization models — rather than building parallel, region-specific tooling.
  • Drive measurable outcomes: Define and track the metrics that matter for the region — win rate, price realization, quote-to-order conversion, margin accuracy, and manufacturability sign-off latency — and use them to prioritize the roadmap.
  • Lead cross-functionally: Act as the hub between Sales, Sourcing, Data Science, Engineering, and regional leadership across Europe, and present strategy, trade-offs, and ROI to executive leadership both regionally and globally.
  • Represent Europe in global strategy: Ensure European market realities — currency, competitive landscape, regulatory nuance, regional manufacturing capacity — shape Xometry's global pricing and AI product direction, rather than being retrofitted after the fact.

What You'll Bring to Xometry:

  • 8+ years of product management experience, including leading AI/ML-powered or technical products in a B2B, marketplace, or manufacturing/engineering environment
  • Experience owning a system of record or complex data contract (e.g., a shared record consumed by multiple downstream systems and roles) and the human-in-the-loop workflows built around it
  • Experience designing policy-driven workflows (e.g., approval routing, tiered sign-off, escalation logic) rather than single-user tools
  • Comfort operating across regions and stakeholder groups to hold a single global design standard, despite real pressure to add customizations
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill technical and operational complexity into a clear narrative for engineers and executives alike
  • Rigorous, data-driven approach to prioritization, experimentation, and measuring impact on cycle time, quality, and customer/partner satisfaction
  • Familiarity with manufacturing processes and DFM principles (CNC machining, sheet metal, additive manufacturing, injection molding) is a strong plus; comfort getting deep into geometry-based feasibility rules is required
  • Track record partnering closely with data science and ML engineering teams to ship models into production — computer vision, 3D/geometric analysis, or applied LLM/VLM experience is a plus
  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business, or a related field; advanced degree (MBA, MS) a plus
 
Xometry is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.

Staff Security Engineer, Incident Response

The Incident Response team's mission is to respond to security threats, incidents and investigations to protect our customers, employees and enterprise data in a fast, efficient and standardised manner. We're a tight-knit team of security incident responders and incident handlers doing "Security for Databricks on Databricks", using our own platform to create near-real-time log analytics, alerting and forensics.

You will be an individual contributor on the security Incident Response (IR) team at Databricks, reporting to the regional IR manager. You will be responsible for conducting security analysis and forensics, responding to high-priority alerts and contributing to automations and agentic capabilities. You will be a security multiplier and help the team scale security incident response at Databricks.

The impact you will have:

  • You will respond to incidents as part of a distributed 24x7 operations and on-call schedule.
  • You will triage and respond to security events and alerts, ensuring quick and effective containment.
  • You will conduct analysis and forensics across a range of data sources to determine the timeline and impact of security events.
  • You will provide technical leadership and influence team direction.
  • You will develop solutions, including leveraging AI and agentic platforms, to deliver autonomous capabilities, expedite your work and scale the impact of the team.
  • You will communicate technical decisions through design docs and tech talks, and mentor junior security responders via security guidance, design reviews and code reviews.

What we look for:

  • Bachelor's Degree AND 7+ years experience in Incident Response work OR Master's Degree AND 5+ years experience.
  • Cloud security expertise in at least 1 of AWS, GCP or Azure, and proficiency in the others.
  • Proficiency in AI/LLM and agentic capabilities. Prefer experience with building and operating agentic systems in a security setting.
  • Broad security subject matter expertise.
  • Expertise in a few core IR skills (DFIR , Reverse Engineering, Traditional Network Security, Storage and access security, Sandboxing, Compute security, etc.).
  • Experience with Enterprise Security and SaaS applications.
  • Working knowledge of a SIEM and SOAR.
  • Experience building Incident Response Tooling, scripting language skills and experience with AI coding tools.

About Databricks

Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. What Makes Cloudbeds Unique
At Cloudbeds, we're not just building software, we’re transforming hospitality. Our intelligently designed platform powers properties across 150 countries, processing billions in bookings annually. From independent properties to hotel groups, we help hoteliers transform operations and uplevel their commercial strategy through a unified platform that integrates with hundreds of partners. And we do it with a completely remote team. Imagine working alongside global innovators to build AI-powered solutions that solve hoteliers' biggest challenges. Since our founding in 2012, we've become the World's Best Hotel PMS Solutions Provider and landed on Deloitte's Technology Fast 500 again in 2024, but we're just getting started. 

Location: Remote (Europe)

How You'll Make an Impact:

As a Staff Software Engineer in Revenue Intelligence, you will shape the technical direction of systems that help hospitality businesses understand demand, identify revenue opportunities, and make better pricing and commercial decisions. You will work across customer-facing applications, backend services, data pipelines, analytical stores, recommendation workflows, and cloud infrastructure. This is a hands-on leadership role: you will solve complex engineering problems directly while establishing architecture, improving reliability and security, reducing systemic technical debt, and aligning multiple teams around durable technical decisions. Your impact will extend beyond individual features to the quality, scalability, operability, and long-term evolution of the Revenue Intelligence platform.

Our Revenue Intelligence Team:

The Revenue Intelligence team builds products and platforms that turn hospitality data into practical decisions for hoteliers, including pricing recommendations, demand insights, reporting, automation, and commercial opportunities. Our systems span frontend experiences, APIs, distributed services, data processing, machine-learning workflows, and production infrastructure. We value pragmatic engineering, strong ownership, evidence-based decisions, and technical leaders who raise the effectiveness of the people and systems around them.

What You Bring to the Team:

  • Set and evolve the technical strategy for Revenue Intelligence, translating product and business goals into coherent architecture and executable engineering plans
  • Lead the design and delivery of complex capabilities across customer-facing web applications, backend APIs, event-driven services, data pipelines, analytical storage, and recommendation workflows
  • Identify and resolve systemic risks in scalability, reliability, security, data quality, observability, and operability before they become recurring customer or engineering problems
  • Drive modernization of legacy systems and infrastructure through incremental, well-reasoned migrations that preserve delivery momentum and production stability
  • Partner with Product, Data Science, Infrastructure, Security, and engineering leaders to define boundaries, contracts, ownership, and long-term platform direction

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience, including significant technical leadership across complex production systems
  • Deep hands-on expertise in Python, with the ability to work effectively across both ecosystems and guide engineering decisions beyond a single language
  • Strong architecture and distributed-systems fundamentals, including API design, event-driven workflows, consistency, failure handling, scalability, and service boundaries
  • Experience with data-intensive systems such as PostgreSQL, Redshift or similar analytical platforms, batch and streaming pipelines, and large-scale data processing
  • Experience designing or operating recommendation systems, machine-learning platforms, pricing systems, experimentation workflows, or other decision-support products
  • Strong cloud and platform engineering experience across AWS, containers, Kubernetes, Terraform, Helm, Argo CD, CI/CD, observability, and secure production operations
  • A demonstrated ability to lead through influence, create alignment across teams, communicate complex tradeoffs clearly, and drive decisions from ambiguity to execution
  • A strong record of improving engineering quality through testing strategy, operational readiness, incident learning, security, documentation, and sustainable technical standards
  • Product judgment and customer empathy, with the ability to connect technical investments to measurable outcomes for hoteliers and the business
  • Business-level English fluency and experience collaborating effectively in a remote, globally distributed organization

Bonus Skills to Stand Out:

  • Deep hands-on expertise in .NET/C#

What to Expect - Your Journey with Us
Behind Cloudbeds' revolutionary technology is a team of redefining what's possible in hospitality. We're 650+ employees across 40+ countries, bringing together elite engineers, AI architects, world-class designers, and hospitality veterans to solve challenges others haven't dared to tackle. Our diverse team speaks 30+ languages, but we all share one language: a passion for innovation and travel. From pioneering breakthroughs in machine learning to revolutionizing how hotels operate, we're not just watching the future of hospitality unfold – we're coding it, designing it, writing it, and shipping it. Mindful movement. It’s at the core of why we do what we do at ALO—it’s our calling. Because mindful movement in the studio leads to better living. Operations Leader

Chez Picnic, notre croissance opérationnelle en France s’accélère : plusieurs nouvelles zones logistiques sont prévues dès fin 2026 et début 2027. En tant que Recruteur / Recruteuse Supply Chain & Opérations, tu joueras un rôle clé dans cette expansion en recrutant les leaders qui construiront et feront grandir nos nouveaux sites logistiques.

Ton périmètre couvre des postes clés pour nos opérations : superviseurs, chefs d’équipe, ingénieurs projets et responsables de sites. Tu travailleras au plus près de nos équipes opérationnelles et de nos Hiring Managers, en comprenant leurs enjeux, en construisant les stratégies de recrutement adaptées et en identifiant les profils capables de faire grandir Picnic.

Chez Picnic, le recrutement ne consiste pas simplement à remplir des postes. Nous voulons construire des équipes solides et durables, avec un haut niveau d’exigence sur les talents que nous recrutons. Tu auras donc une vraie autonomie sur tes recrutements : tu définiras tes priorités, piloteras tes pipelines et challengeras les approches lorsque cela sera nécessaire pour atteindre tes objectifs sans faire de compromis sur la qualité.

Tu seras également un véritable partenaire du business : tes Hiring Managers sont directement impliqués dans le recrutement et considèrent la construction de leur équipe comme une priorité. Ton rôle sera de leur apporter ton expertise recrutement, de faciliter les prises de décision et de les conseiller tout au long du processus.

  • Piloter tes recrutements de A à Z : tu prends en charge tes recrutements, de la définition du besoin jusqu’à la signature, et construis les pipelines nécessaires pour atteindre tes objectifs.

  • Accompagner notre expansion en France : tu recrutes les profils clés qui permettront l’ouverture et le développement de nos nouveaux sites logistiques.

  • Définir ta stratégie de recrutement : tu identifies les bons profils, marchés et canaux de sourcing, et adaptes ton approche en fonction de tes résultats.

  • Être un partenaire du business : tu travailles main dans la main avec tes Hiring Managers, les conseilles sur leurs recrutements et les challenges lorsque nécessaire.

  • Maintenir un haut niveau d’exigence : tu évalues les candidats avec rigueur et veilles à construire des équipes solides et durables.

À propos de toi

  • Tu as 2 à 5 ans d’expérience en recrutement, idéalement dans un environnement à forte croissance ou en évolution rapide.
  • Tu sais prendre des décisions en autonomie et construire une stratégie de recrutement pour atteindre tes objectifs.
  • Tu es à l’aise pour conseiller et challenger tes Hiring Managers, tout en construisant une relation de confiance avec eux.
  • Tu accordes beaucoup d’importance à la qualité des recrutements et sais maintenir un niveau d’exigence élevé.
  • Tu es structuré.e, organisé.e et capable de gérer plusieurs recrutements et priorités en parallèle.
  • Tu maîtrises parfaitement le français et l’anglais, à l’oral comme à l’écrit.
  • Tu es diplômé.e d’un Master en commerce, ressources humaines, psychologie ou dans un domaine similaire.
  • Chez Picnic, nous utilisons Greenhouse comme ATS. C’est un plus si tu le connais déjà, mais pas indispensable.

Avantages Picnic

 

🍴 Restauration 

Comme nous sommes implantés au centre de Paris, pas de cantine sur place. Par contre, des tickets restaurant d’une valeur de 11€ par jour sont remis afin de tester tous les délicieux restaurants du coin. Notre petite cuisine est également équipée de savoureux en-cas et rafraîchissements.

Grâce à nos partenariats avec Sidecare et OpenUp, tu as la possibilité de souscrire à notre mutuelle d’entreprise ainsi qu’à un accès facile et gratuit à des psychologues professionnels, des ateliers et des outils pratiques. De plus, si tu te rends au travail en transports en commun, nous te remboursons ton abonnement à hauteur de 50%.

✍️ Développement personnel et professionnel

Tu auras l’opportunité de développer tes compétences, non seulement au travers de projets stimulants, mais aussi grâce à un environnement dynamique, jeune et international.

🎫Sorties et divertissement

Profite d'un accès à des offres et avantages exclusifs via notre CSE et partenaire Swile (bons d'achats, places de concert, cinéma, et plus encore). Tu profiteras aussi d'inviations à tous nos événements récurrents comme notre très convoitée Summer Party !
